"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
A0 Portrait at 150dpi for manageable file size with high visual quality.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ── Canvas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
NAVY_MID   = (16,  25,  62)
SLATE      = (30,  42,  80)
SLATE_LIGHT= (52,  68, 108)
AMBER      = (255, 180,  40)
VERMILION  = (220,  72,  40)
DEEP_RED   = (165,  20,  20)
TEAL       = ( 60, 180, 170)
TEAL_DIM   = ( 40, 120, 115)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
WHITE_70   = (255, 255, 255, 178)
WHITE_40   = (255, 255, 255, 102)
WHITE_20   = (255, 255, 255,  51)
GOLD       = (200, 155,  50)
CREAM      = (240, 232, 210)

# ── Font loader ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

# Primary text: InstrumentSans (clean institutional sans-serif)
# Data / mono: IBMPlexMono
# Display: BigShoulders (condensed, bold impact)
# Accent: Jura (thin, technical)

def make_poster():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

    M = int(W * 0.045)   # margin ~210px

    # ── 1. Background texture: fine grid dots ────────────────────────────────
    grid_step = 48
    for gx in range(0, W, grid_step):
        for gy in range(0, H, grid_step):
            r = 1
            draw.ellipse([gx-r, gy-r, gx+r, gy+r], fill=(255,255,255,18))

    # ── 2. Vertical thermal gradient strip (far left) ────────────────────────
    strip_w = int(W * 0.012)
    for y in range(H):
        t = y / H
        # cool→warm bottom→top mapping (bottom=cool/teal, top=deep red)
        if t < 0.3:
            r = int(40 + t/0.3 * (AMBER[0]-40))
            g = int(120 + t/0.3 * (AMBER[1]-120))
            b = int(115 + t/0.3 * (AMBER[2]-115))
        elif t < 0.6:
            tt = (t-0.3)/0.3
            r = int(AMBER[0] + tt*(VERMILION[0]-AMBER[0]))
            g = int(AMBER[1] + tt*(VERMILION[1]-AMBER[1]))
            b = int(AMBER[2] + tt*(VERMILION[2]-AMBER[2]))
        else:
            tt = (t-0.6)/0.4
            r = int(VERMILION[0] + tt*(DEEP_RED[0]-VERMILION[0]))
            g = int(VERMILION[1] + tt*(DEEP_RED[1]-VERMILION[1]))
            b = int(VERMILION[2] + tt*(DEEP_RED[2]-VERMILION[2]))
        col = (r, g, b)
        # inverted: top = hottest
        inv_y = H - 1 - y
        draw.line([(0, inv_y), (strip_w, inv_y)], fill=col)

    # Thin separator line next to strip
    draw.line([(strip_w+2, 0), (strip_w+2, H)], fill=(255,255,255,40), width=1)

    # ── 3. Header zone ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    header_y = int(H * 0.005)

    # IPCC label top-left (above title)
    f_jura_sm  = font("Jura-Light.ttf", 32)
    f_jura_med = font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 36)
    f_inst_reg = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
    f_inst_bold= font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 46)
    f_big_bold = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 260)
    f_big_reg  = font("BigShoulders-Regular.ttf", 80)
    f_mono_reg = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 34)
    f_mono_bold= font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 42)
    f_work_bold= font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 44)
    f_work_reg = font("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
    f_crimson  = font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 40)
    f_outfit   = font("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 34)
    f_outfit_b = font("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 38)

    x0 = M + strip_w + 40  # text start x

    # IPCC badge / label
    draw.text((x0, header_y + 40), "IPCC", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 56),
              fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((x0 + 130, header_y + 58), "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  2023",
              font=f_jura_med, fill=(180, 200, 220))

    # Main title — two lines, large
    title_y = header_y + 130
    f_title = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 148)
    f_title2 = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 148)
    draw.text((x0, title_y), "CLIMATE", font=f_title, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((x0, title_y + 148), "CHANGE", font=f_title2, fill=WHITE)

    # Year + report name in smaller text, right-aligned
    year_font = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 52)
    draw.text((x0, title_y + 300), "2023", font=year_font, fill=AMBER)
    subtitle_font = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
    sub_text = "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings"
    draw.text((x0, title_y + 362), sub_text, font=subtitle_font, fill=(180,200,220))

    # Thin rule under header
    rule_y = title_y + 420
    draw.line([(x0, rule_y), (W - M, rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,50), width=1)
    draw.line([(x0, rule_y + 4), (W - M, rule_y + 4)], fill=AMBER + (80,), width=1)

    # ── 4. SECTION: Observed Changes ─────────────────────────────────────────
    sec1_y = rule_y + 40

    # Section label
    draw.text((x0, sec1_y), "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=TEAL)

    # Metric grid — three large stats across top
    metrics_y = sec1_y + 55
    col_w = (W - M - x0 - 40) // 3

    def draw_metric(x, y, value, unit, label, accent):
        """Draw a large metric callout."""
        # Background card
        card_pad = 24
        card_h = 210
        card_w = col_w - 20
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x+card_w, y+card_h],
                        fill=(255,255,255,10), outline=accent+(60,), width=1)
        # Value
        val_font = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)
        draw.text((x+card_pad, y+8), value, font=val_font, fill=accent)
        if unit:
            unit_font = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 30)
            vbb = val_font.getbbox(value)
            unit_x = x + card_pad + vbb[2] + 8
            draw.text((unit_x, y+60), unit, font=unit_font, fill=accent+(200,))
        # Label
        lbl_font = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
        # wrap label
        words = label.split()
        lines_lbl = []
        cur = ""
        for w in words:
            test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
            bb = lbl_font.getbbox(test)
            if bb[2] > card_w - card_pad*2:
                lines_lbl.append(cur)
                cur = w
            else:
                cur = test
        if cur:
            lines_lbl.append(cur)
        ly = y + card_h - 20 - len(lines_lbl)*32
        for ll in lines_lbl:
            draw.text((x+card_pad, ly), ll, font=lbl_font, fill=(180,200,220))
            ly += 32

    mx = x0
    draw_metric(mx, metrics_y, "1.1", "°C", "Global surface temperature rise (2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900)", AMBER)
    mx += col_w
    draw_metric(mx, metrics_y, "410", "ppm", "Atmospheric CO₂ in 2019 — highest in 2 million years", VERMILION)
    mx += col_w
    draw_metric(mx, metrics_y, "59", "GtCO₂e", "Global GHG emissions in 2019", DEEP_RED)

    # Secondary observed data strip
    obs2_y = metrics_y + 240
    draw.text((x0, obs2_y),
              "Sea level rise 1901–2018:  +0.20 m      ·      Arctic sea ice (Sept):  −40% area loss  (1979–2020)",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(160, 190, 215))

    # Thin divider
    obs_rule_y = obs2_y + 52
    draw.line([(x0, obs_rule_y), (W-M, obs_rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,25), width=1)

    # ── 5. SECTION: Future Projections (SSP Scenarios) ───────────────────────
    proj_y = obs_rule_y + 35

    draw.text((x0, proj_y), "FUTURE PROJECTIONS  ·  SSP SCENARIOS",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=TEAL)

    # Visual scenario bars — diverging horizontal bars from a common baseline
    bar_y = proj_y + 60
    bar_area_w = W - M - x0 - 20
    bar_label_w = int(bar_area_w * 0.22)
    bar_graph_w = bar_area_w - bar_label_w - 160
    bar_h = 52
    bar_gap = 14
    max_temp = 4.4

    scenarios = [
        ("SSP1-1.9", 1.4,  TEAL,       "Very low emissions · Sustainability"),
        ("SSP1-2.6", 1.8,  (80,200,180),"Low emissions"),
        ("SSP2-4.5", 2.7,  AMBER,       "Intermediate emissions"),
        ("SSP3-7.0", 3.6,  VERMILION,   "High emissions"),
        ("SSP5-8.5", 4.4,  DEEP_RED,    "Very high emissions · Fossil-fuel intensive"),
    ]

    # Baseline label
    draw.text((x0 + bar_label_w + 4, bar_y - 28),
              "◀ BASELINE  1.1°C  ──────  PROJECTED WARMING BY 2100",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 24), fill=(160,190,215))

    for i, (name, val, color, desc) in enumerate(scenarios):
        by = bar_y + i * (bar_h + bar_gap)
        # Label
        draw.text((x0, by + bar_h//2 - 14),
                  name, font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 30), fill=color)
        # Bar (starts at baseline 1.1°C visual position)
        baseline_frac = 1.1 / max_temp
        bar_start = x0 + bar_label_w + int(baseline_frac * bar_graph_w)
        bar_end   = x0 + bar_label_w + int((val / max_temp) * bar_graph_w)
        # Thin baseline track
        draw.rectangle([x0+bar_label_w, by + bar_h//2 - 1,
                         x0+bar_label_w+bar_graph_w, by + bar_h//2 + 1],
                        fill=(255,255,255,20))
        # Colored bar
        draw.rectangle([bar_start, by + 10, bar_end, by + bar_h - 10],
                        fill=color + (200,))
        # Value label
        val_x = bar_end + 10
        draw.text((val_x, by + bar_h//2 - 20),
                  f"{val}°C", font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 36), fill=color)
        # Description (right side)
        desc_x = val_x + 100
        if desc_x + 400 < W - M:
            draw.text((desc_x, by + bar_h//2 - 12),
                      desc, font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24),
                      fill=(140,165,195))

    # 1.5°C threshold marker line
    thresh_x = x0 + bar_label_w + int((1.5/max_temp)*bar_graph_w)
    bar_zone_top = bar_y - 6
    bar_zone_bot = bar_y + len(scenarios)*(bar_h+bar_gap) - bar_gap + 6
    draw.line([(thresh_x, bar_zone_top), (thresh_x, bar_zone_bot)],
              fill=TEAL+(160,), width=2)
    draw.text((thresh_x + 6, bar_zone_top),
              "1.5°C", font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 26), fill=TEAL)

    # 2°C threshold
    thresh2_x = x0 + bar_label_w + int((2.0/max_temp)*bar_graph_w)
    draw.line([(thresh2_x, bar_zone_top), (thresh2_x, bar_zone_bot)],
              fill=AMBER+(100,), width=1)
    draw.text((thresh2_x + 4, bar_zone_top),
              "2.0°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 24), fill=AMBER+(160,))

    # Sea level projection note
    slr_y = bar_zone_bot + 18
    draw.text((x0, slr_y),
              "Sea level rise by 2100:  SSP1-1.9 → 0.28–0.55 m     ·     SSP5-8.5 → 0.63–1.01 m  (continued rise for centuries)",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(140,165,195))

    proj_rule_y = slr_y + 50
    draw.line([(x0, proj_rule_y), (W-M, proj_rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,25), width=1)

    # ── 6. SECTION: Risks & Impacts ──────────────────────────────────────────
    risk_y = proj_rule_y + 35

    draw.text((x0, risk_y), "RISKS  ·  VULNERABILITIES  ·  CASCADING IMPACTS",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=TEAL)

    # HERO STAT: 3.3–3.6 billion
    hero_y = risk_y + 60
    hero_font = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 200)
    draw.text((x0, hero_y), "3.3–3.6", font=hero_font, fill=DEEP_RED)
    bil_font = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90)
    draw.text((x0, hero_y + 196), "BILLION PEOPLE", font=bil_font, fill=VERMILION)
    exp_font = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
    draw.text((x0, hero_y + 292), "exposed to severe climate hazards", font=exp_font,
              fill=(200, 215, 230))

    # Right-side: impact bullets
    impact_x = x0 + int((W - M - x0) * 0.52)
    impact_y = hero_y + 20
    impacts = [
        ("FOOD",    "Crop yield growth slowing;\nfisheries declining in tropical zones"),
        ("WATER",   ">50% of population faces severe\nwater scarcity ≥1 month/year"),
        ("HEALTH",  "Heat-related mortality rising;\nvector-borne disease ranges expanding"),
        ("BIODIV.", "Up to 14% terrestrial species at\nhigh extinction risk at 1.5°C"),
    ]
    f_impact_label = font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
    f_impact_body  = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
    for j, (label, body) in enumerate(impacts):
        iy = impact_y + j * 110
        draw.text((impact_x, iy), label, font=f_impact_label, fill=AMBER)
        lines_b = body.split("\n")
        for k, ln in enumerate(lines_b):
            draw.text((impact_x + 140, iy + k*30 + 2), ln, font=f_impact_body,
                      fill=(175, 200, 225))

    risk_rule_y = hero_y + 340
    draw.line([(x0, risk_rule_y), (W-M, risk_rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,25), width=1)

    # ── 7. SECTION: Mitigation & Adaptation ──────────────────────────────────
    mit_y = risk_rule_y + 35

    draw.text((x0, mit_y), "MITIGATION PATHWAYS  ·  ADAPTATION",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=TEAL)

    # Two-column layout
    col1_x = x0
    col2_x = x0 + int((W - M - x0) * 0.5) + 20
    mit_content_y = mit_y + 58

    # Left: 43% reduction hero stat
    pct_font = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 220)
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y), "43%", font=pct_font, fill=AMBER)
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y + 212), "REQUIRED REDUCTION",
              font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=AMBER)
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y + 288),
              "in global GHG emissions by 2030\nbelow 2019 levels · 1.5°C pathway",
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=(200,215,230))

    # Net zero annotation
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y + 372),
              "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2050  (1.5°C)",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y + 408),
              "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2070  (2.0°C)",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=(100,160,155))

    # Carbon budget box
    draw.rectangle([col1_x, mit_content_y + 452,
                    col1_x + int((W-M-x0)*0.44), mit_content_y + 520],
                   fill=(255,255,255,8), outline=TEAL+(80,), width=1)
    draw.text((col1_x + 20, mit_content_y + 462),
              "Remaining carbon budget for 1.5°C (50% chance):  ~500 GtCO₂  from 2020",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(160,195,215))

    # Right: key levers
    levers = [
        "Rapid decarbonization of energy systems",
        "Electrification of transport",
        "Demand-side efficiency improvements",
        "Protection & restoration of carbon sinks",
        "Scaled climate finance (gap: 3–6× current)",
    ]
    draw.text((col2_x, mit_content_y), "KEY LEVERS",
              font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 40), fill=(200,215,230))
    f_lever = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
    for j, lever in enumerate(levers):
        ly2 = mit_content_y + 58 + j * 56
        # dot
        draw.ellipse([col2_x, ly2+10, col2_x+10, ly2+20], fill=TEAL)
        draw.text((col2_x + 24, ly2), lever, font=f_lever, fill=(190,210,230))

    # 27% note for 2°C
    draw.text((col2_x, mit_content_y + 360),
              "27% reduction by 2030 for 2°C pathway",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(140,175,195))

    mit_rule_y = mit_content_y + 550
    draw.line([(x0, mit_rule_y), (W-M, mit_rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,25), width=1)

    # ── 8. SECTION: Narrowing Window ─────────────────────────────────────────
    nw_y = mit_rule_y + 35

    draw.text((x0, nw_y), "THE NARROWING WINDOW FOR ACTION",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=VERMILION)

    # Urgency statement — large italic serif
    urg_font = font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 54)
    urg_text = "Choices made this decade will determine whether warming is held to 1.5°C or 2°C."
    # word-wrap
    urg_words = urg_text.split()
    urg_lines = []
    cur_line = ""
    max_urg_w = W - M - x0 - 20
    for word in urg_words:
        test = (cur_line + " " + word).strip()
        bb = urg_font.getbbox(test)
        if bb[2] > max_urg_w:
            urg_lines.append(cur_line)
            cur_line = word
        else:
            cur_line = test
    if cur_line:
        urg_lines.append(cur_line)
    urg_content_y = nw_y + 55
    for line in urg_lines:
        draw.text((x0, urg_content_y), line, font=urg_font, fill=CREAM)
        urg_content_y += 60

    # Three consequence pillars
    pill_y = urg_content_y + 24
    pillars = [
        (DEEP_RED,    "COST",      "Delayed action exponentially increases\nmitigation costs across all sectors"),
        (VERMILION,   "LOCK-IN",   "High-carbon infrastructure lock-in\nreduces future feasibility of action"),
        (AMBER,       "FINANCE",   "Climate finance falls 3–6× short\nof adaptation needs globally"),
    ]
    pill_w = (W - M - x0 - 40) // 3
    for j, (color, title, body) in enumerate(pillars):
        px = x0 + j * (pill_w + 20)
        draw.rectangle([px, pill_y, px+pill_w, pill_y+180],
                        fill=color+(20,), outline=color+(100,), width=2)
        draw.text((px+20, pill_y+16), title,
                  font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68), fill=color)
        lines_p = body.split("\n")
        for k, ln in enumerate(lines_p):
            draw.text((px+20, pill_y+86+k*34), ln,
                      font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(190,210,230))

    nw_rule_y = pill_y + 210
    draw.line([(x0, nw_rule_y), (W-M, nw_rule_y)], fill=DEEP_RED+(60,), width=2)

    # Final call-to-action statement
    cta_y = nw_rule_y + 28
    cta_font = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 44)
    cta_text = "IMMEDIATE  ·  DEEP  ·  SUSTAINED"
    draw.text((x0, cta_y), cta_text, font=cta_font, fill=AMBER)
    draw.text((x0, cta_y + 56),
              "Emissions reductions across all sectors and scales — essential for a liveable future.",
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=(200,215,230))

    # ── 9. Footer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    footer_y = H - 100
    draw.line([(x0, footer_y), (W-M, footer_y)], fill=(255,255,255,20), width=1)
    draw.text((x0, footer_y + 16),
              "Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 24), fill=(120,150,175))
    draw.text((W - M - 300, footer_y + 16),
              "AR6 · SYR · 2023",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 24), fill=(120,150,175))

    # ── 10. Right-edge vertical text label ───────────────────────────────────
    # Rotate "SYNTHESIS REPORT" vertically on right margin
    label_font = font("BigShoulders-Regular.ttf", 52)
    label_text = "SYNTHESIS  REPORT  AR6"
    label_img = Image.new("RGBA", (600, 40), (0,0,0,0))
    label_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(label_img)
    label_draw.text((0, 0), label_text, font=label_font, fill=(255,255,255,30))
    label_rot = label_img.rotate(90, expand=True)
    lx = W - int(W*0.028) - label_rot.width
    ly = (H - label_rot.height) // 2
    img.paste(label_rot, (lx, ly), label_rot)

    # ── 11. Decorative: concentric arc bottom-right ───────────────────────────
    arc_cx = W - M + 60
    arc_cy = H - M + 60
    for ar in range(8):
        r_arc = 120 + ar * 90
        alpha = max(5, 40 - ar*5)
        # Draw arc manually as series of small lines
        for angle_deg in range(160, 271):
            a = math.radians(angle_deg)
            ax1 = arc_cx + int((r_arc-2)*math.cos(a))
            ay1 = arc_cy + int((r_arc-2)*math.sin(a))
            ax2 = arc_cx + int(r_arc*math.cos(a))
            ay2 = arc_cy + int(r_arc*math.sin(a))
            draw.line([(ax1,ay1),(ax2,ay2)], fill=(255,255,255,alpha))

    # ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    out_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
    img.save(out_path, "PNG", dpi=(DPI, DPI))
    print(f"Saved: {out_path}  ({W}×{H} px)")
    return out_path

if __name__ == "__main__":
    make_poster()

"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
A0 Portrait at 150dpi for manageable file size with high visual quality.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ── Canvas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
NAVY_MID   = (16,  25,  62)
SLATE      = (30,  42,  80)
SLATE_LIGHT= (52,  68, 108)
AMBER      = (255, 180,  40)
VERMILION  = (220,  72,  40)
DEEP_RED   = (165,  20,  20)
TEAL       = ( 60, 180, 170)
TEAL_DIM   = ( 40, 120, 115)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
WHITE_70   = (255, 255, 255, 178)
WHITE_40   = (255, 255, 255, 102)
WHITE_20   = (255, 255, 255,  51)
GOLD       = (200, 155,  50)
CREAM      = (240, 232, 210)

# ── Font loader ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

# Primary text: InstrumentSans (clean institutional sans-serif)
# Data / mono: IBMPlexMono
# Display: BigShoulders (condensed, bold impact)
# Accent: Jura (thin, technical)

def make_poster():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

    M = int(W * 0.045)   # margin ~210px

    # ── 1. Background texture: fine grid dots ────────────────────────────────
    grid_step = 48
    for gx in range(0, W, grid_step):
        for gy in range(0, H, grid_step):
            r = 1
            draw.ellipse([gx-r, gy-r, gx+r, gy+r], fill=(255,255,255,18))

    # ── 2. Vertical thermal gradient strip (far left) ────────────────────────
    strip_w = int(W * 0.012)
    for y in range(H):
        t = y / H
        # cool→warm bottom→top mapping (bottom=cool/teal, top=deep red)
        if t < 0.3:
            r = int(40 + t/0.3 * (AMBER[0]-40))
            g = int(120 + t/0.3 * (AMBER[1]-120))
            b = int(115 + t/0.3 * (AMBER[2]-115))
        elif t < 0.6:
            tt = (t-0.3)/0.3
            r = int(AMBER[0] + tt*(VERMILION[0]-AMBER[0]))
            g = int(AMBER[1] + tt*(VERMILION[1]-AMBER[1]))
            b = int(AMBER[2] + tt*(VERMILION[2]-AMBER[2]))
        else:
            tt = (t-0.6)/0.4
            r = int(VERMILION[0] + tt*(DEEP_RED[0]-VERMILION[0]))
            g = int(VERMILION[1] + tt*(DEEP_RED[1]-VERMILION[1]))
            b = int(VERMILION[2] + tt*(DEEP_RED[2]-VERMILION[2]))
        col = (r, g, b)
        # inverted: top = hottest
        inv_y = H - 1 - y
        draw.line([(0, inv_y), (strip_w, inv_y)], fill=col)

    # Thin separator line next to strip
    draw.line([(strip_w+2, 0), (strip_w+2, H)], fill=(255,255,255,40), width=1)

    # ── 3. Header zone ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    header_y = int(H * 0.005)

    # IPCC label top-left (above title)
    f_jura_sm  = font("Jura-Light.ttf", 32)
    f_jura_med = font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 36)
    f_inst_reg = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
    f_inst_bold= font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 46)
    f_big_bold = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 260)
    f_big_reg  = font("BigShoulders-Regular.ttf", 80)
    f_mono_reg = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 34)
    f_mono_bold= font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 42)
    f_work_bold= font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 44)
    f_work_reg = font("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
    f_crimson  = font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 40)
    f_outfit   = font("Outfit-Regular.ttf", 34)
    f_outfit_b = font("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 38)

    x0 = M + strip_w + 40  # text start x

    # IPCC badge / label
    draw.text((x0, header_y + 40), "IPCC", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 56),
              fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((x0 + 130, header_y + 58), "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  2023",
              font=f_jura_med, fill=(180, 200, 220))

    # Main title — two lines, large
    title_y = header_y + 130
    f_title = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 148)
    f_title2 = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 148)
    draw.text((x0, title_y), "CLIMATE", font=f_title, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((x0, title_y + 148), "CHANGE", font=f_title2, fill=WHITE)

    # Year + report name in smaller text, right-aligned
    year_font = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 52)
    draw.text((x0, title_y + 300), "2023", font=year_font, fill=AMBER)
    subtitle_font = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
    sub_text = "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings"
    draw.text((x0, title_y + 362), sub_text, font=subtitle_font, fill=(180,200,220))

    # Thin rule under header
    rule_y = title_y + 420
    draw.line([(x0, rule_y), (W - M, rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,50), width=1)
    draw.line([(x0, rule_y + 4), (W - M, rule_y + 4)], fill=AMBER + (80,), width=1)

    # ── 4. SECTION: Observed Changes ─────────────────────────────────────────
    sec1_y = rule_y + 40

    # Section label
    draw.text((x0, sec1_y), "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=TEAL)

    # Metric grid — three large stats across top
    metrics_y = sec1_y + 55
    col_w = (W - M - x0 - 40) // 3

    def draw_metric(x, y, value, unit, label, accent):
        """Draw a large metric callout."""
        # Background card
        card_pad = 24
        card_h = 210
        card_w = col_w - 20
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x+card_w, y+card_h],
                        fill=(255,255,255,10), outline=accent+(60,), width=1)
        # Value
        val_font = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)
        draw.text((x+card_pad, y+8), value, font=val_font, fill=accent)
        if unit:
            unit_font = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 30)
            vbb = val_font.getbbox(value)
            unit_x = x + card_pad + vbb[2] + 8
            draw.text((unit_x, y+60), unit, font=unit_font, fill=accent+(200,))
        # Label
        lbl_font = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
        # wrap label
        words = label.split()
        lines_lbl = []
        cur = ""
        for w in words:
            test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
            bb = lbl_font.getbbox(test)
            if bb[2] > card_w - card_pad*2:
                lines_lbl.append(cur)
                cur = w
            else:
                cur = test
        if cur:
            lines_lbl.append(cur)
        ly = y + card_h - 20 - len(lines_lbl)*32
        for ll in lines_lbl:
            draw.text((x+card_pad, ly), ll, font=lbl_font, fill=(180,200,220))
            ly += 32

    mx = x0
    draw_metric(mx, metrics_y, "1.1", "°C", "Global surface temperature rise (2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900)", AMBER)
    mx += col_w
    draw_metric(mx, metrics_y, "410", "ppm", "Atmospheric CO₂ in 2019 — highest in 2 million years", VERMILION)
    mx += col_w
    draw_metric(mx, metrics_y, "59", "GtCO₂e", "Global GHG emissions in 2019", DEEP_RED)

    # Secondary observed data strip
    obs2_y = metrics_y + 240
    draw.text((x0, obs2_y),
              "Sea level rise 1901–2018:  +0.20 m      ·      Arctic sea ice (Sept):  −40% area loss  (1979–2020)",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(160, 190, 215))

    # Thin divider
    obs_rule_y = obs2_y + 52
    draw.line([(x0, obs_rule_y), (W-M, obs_rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,25), width=1)

    # ── 5. SECTION: Future Projections (SSP Scenarios) ───────────────────────
    proj_y = obs_rule_y + 35

    draw.text((x0, proj_y), "FUTURE PROJECTIONS  ·  SSP SCENARIOS",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=TEAL)

    # Visual scenario bars — diverging horizontal bars from a common baseline
    bar_y = proj_y + 60
    bar_area_w = W - M - x0 - 20
    bar_label_w = int(bar_area_w * 0.22)
    bar_graph_w = bar_area_w - bar_label_w - 160
    bar_h = 52
    bar_gap = 14
    max_temp = 4.4

    scenarios = [
        ("SSP1-1.9", 1.4,  TEAL,       "Very low emissions · Sustainability"),
        ("SSP1-2.6", 1.8,  (80,200,180),"Low emissions"),
        ("SSP2-4.5", 2.7,  AMBER,       "Intermediate emissions"),
        ("SSP3-7.0", 3.6,  VERMILION,   "High emissions"),
        ("SSP5-8.5", 4.4,  DEEP_RED,    "Very high emissions · Fossil-fuel intensive"),
    ]

    # Baseline label
    draw.text((x0 + bar_label_w + 4, bar_y - 28),
              "◀ BASELINE  1.1°C  ──────  PROJECTED WARMING BY 2100",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 24), fill=(160,190,215))

    for i, (name, val, color, desc) in enumerate(scenarios):
        by = bar_y + i * (bar_h + bar_gap)
        # Label
        draw.text((x0, by + bar_h//2 - 14),
                  name, font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 30), fill=color)
        # Bar (starts at baseline 1.1°C visual position)
        baseline_frac = 1.1 / max_temp
        bar_start = x0 + bar_label_w + int(baseline_frac * bar_graph_w)
        bar_end   = x0 + bar_label_w + int((val / max_temp) * bar_graph_w)
        # Thin baseline track
        draw.rectangle([x0+bar_label_w, by + bar_h//2 - 1,
                         x0+bar_label_w+bar_graph_w, by + bar_h//2 + 1],
                        fill=(255,255,255,20))
        # Colored bar
        draw.rectangle([bar_start, by + 10, bar_end, by + bar_h - 10],
                        fill=color + (200,))
        # Value label
        val_x = bar_end + 10
        draw.text((val_x, by + bar_h//2 - 20),
                  f"{val}°C", font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 36), fill=color)
        # Description (right side)
        desc_x = val_x + 100
        if desc_x + 400 < W - M:
            draw.text((desc_x, by + bar_h//2 - 12),
                      desc, font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24),
                      fill=(140,165,195))

    # 1.5°C threshold marker line
    thresh_x = x0 + bar_label_w + int((1.5/max_temp)*bar_graph_w)
    bar_zone_top = bar_y - 6
    bar_zone_bot = bar_y + len(scenarios)*(bar_h+bar_gap) - bar_gap + 6
    draw.line([(thresh_x, bar_zone_top), (thresh_x, bar_zone_bot)],
              fill=TEAL+(160,), width=2)
    draw.text((thresh_x + 6, bar_zone_top),
              "1.5°C", font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 26), fill=TEAL)

    # 2°C threshold
    thresh2_x = x0 + bar_label_w + int((2.0/max_temp)*bar_graph_w)
    draw.line([(thresh2_x, bar_zone_top), (thresh2_x, bar_zone_bot)],
              fill=AMBER+(100,), width=1)
    draw.text((thresh2_x + 4, bar_zone_top),
              "2.0°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 24), fill=AMBER+(160,))

    # Sea level projection note
    slr_y = bar_zone_bot + 18
    draw.text((x0, slr_y),
              "Sea level rise by 2100:  SSP1-1.9 → 0.28–0.55 m     ·     SSP5-8.5 → 0.63–1.01 m  (continued rise for centuries)",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(140,165,195))

    proj_rule_y = slr_y + 50
    draw.line([(x0, proj_rule_y), (W-M, proj_rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,25), width=1)

    # ── 6. SECTION: Risks & Impacts ──────────────────────────────────────────
    risk_y = proj_rule_y + 35

    draw.text((x0, risk_y), "RISKS  ·  VULNERABILITIES  ·  CASCADING IMPACTS",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=TEAL)

    # HERO STAT: 3.3–3.6 billion
    hero_y = risk_y + 60
    hero_font = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 200)
    draw.text((x0, hero_y), "3.3–3.6", font=hero_font, fill=DEEP_RED)
    bil_font = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90)
    draw.text((x0, hero_y + 196), "BILLION PEOPLE", font=bil_font, fill=VERMILION)
    exp_font = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
    draw.text((x0, hero_y + 292), "exposed to severe climate hazards", font=exp_font,
              fill=(200, 215, 230))

    # Right-side: impact bullets
    impact_x = x0 + int((W - M - x0) * 0.52)
    impact_y = hero_y + 20
    impacts = [
        ("FOOD",    "Crop yield growth slowing;\nfisheries declining in tropical zones"),
        ("WATER",   ">50% of population faces severe\nwater scarcity ≥1 month/year"),
        ("HEALTH",  "Heat-related mortality rising;\nvector-borne disease ranges expanding"),
        ("BIODIV.", "Up to 14% terrestrial species at\nhigh extinction risk at 1.5°C"),
    ]
    f_impact_label = font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
    f_impact_body  = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
    for j, (label, body) in enumerate(impacts):
        iy = impact_y + j * 110
        draw.text((impact_x, iy), label, font=f_impact_label, fill=AMBER)
        lines_b = body.split("\n")
        for k, ln in enumerate(lines_b):
            draw.text((impact_x + 140, iy + k*30 + 2), ln, font=f_impact_body,
                      fill=(175, 200, 225))

    risk_rule_y = hero_y + 340
    draw.line([(x0, risk_rule_y), (W-M, risk_rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,25), width=1)

    # ── 7. SECTION: Mitigation & Adaptation ──────────────────────────────────
    mit_y = risk_rule_y + 35

    draw.text((x0, mit_y), "MITIGATION PATHWAYS  ·  ADAPTATION",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=TEAL)

    # Two-column layout
    col1_x = x0
    col2_x = x0 + int((W - M - x0) * 0.5) + 20
    mit_content_y = mit_y + 58

    # Left: 43% reduction hero stat
    pct_font = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 220)
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y), "43%", font=pct_font, fill=AMBER)
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y + 212), "REQUIRED REDUCTION",
              font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=AMBER)
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y + 288),
              "in global GHG emissions by 2030\nbelow 2019 levels · 1.5°C pathway",
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=(200,215,230))

    # Net zero annotation
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y + 372),
              "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2050  (1.5°C)",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((col1_x, mit_content_y + 408),
              "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2070  (2.0°C)",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=(100,160,155))

    # Carbon budget box
    draw.rectangle([col1_x, mit_content_y + 452,
                    col1_x + int((W-M-x0)*0.44), mit_content_y + 520],
                   fill=(255,255,255,8), outline=TEAL+(80,), width=1)
    draw.text((col1_x + 20, mit_content_y + 462),
              "Remaining carbon budget for 1.5°C (50% chance):  ~500 GtCO₂  from 2020",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(160,195,215))

    # Right: key levers
    levers = [
        "Rapid decarbonization of energy systems",
        "Electrification of transport",
        "Demand-side efficiency improvements",
        "Protection & restoration of carbon sinks",
        "Scaled climate finance (gap: 3–6× current)",
    ]
    draw.text((col2_x, mit_content_y), "KEY LEVERS",
              font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 40), fill=(200,215,230))
    f_lever = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
    for j, lever in enumerate(levers):
        ly2 = mit_content_y + 58 + j * 56
        # dot
        draw.ellipse([col2_x, ly2+10, col2_x+10, ly2+20], fill=TEAL)
        draw.text((col2_x + 24, ly2), lever, font=f_lever, fill=(190,210,230))

    # 27% note for 2°C
    draw.text((col2_x, mit_content_y + 360),
              "27% reduction by 2030 for 2°C pathway",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(140,175,195))

    mit_rule_y = mit_content_y + 550
    draw.line([(x0, mit_rule_y), (W-M, mit_rule_y)], fill=(255,255,255,25), width=1)

    # ── 8. SECTION: Narrowing Window ─────────────────────────────────────────
    nw_y = mit_rule_y + 35

    draw.text((x0, nw_y), "THE NARROWING WINDOW FOR ACTION",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=VERMILION)

    # Urgency statement — large italic serif
    urg_font = font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 54)
    urg_text = "Choices made this decade will determine whether warming is held to 1.5°C or 2°C."
    # word-wrap

    for line in urg_lines:

    # Three consequence pillars
    pill_y = urg_content_y + 24
    pillars = [
        (DEEP_RED,    "COST",      "Delayed action exponentially increases\nmitigation costs across all sectors"),
        (VERMILION,   "LOCK-IN",   "High-carbon infrastructure lock-in\nreduces future feasibility of action"),
        (AMBER,       "FINANCE",   "Climate finance falls 3–6× short\nof adaptation needs globally"),
    ]
    pill_w = (W - M - x0 - 40) // 3
    for j, (color, title, body) in enumerate(pillars):
        px = x0 + j * (pill_w + 20)
        draw.rectangle([px, pill_y, px+pill_w, pill_y+180],
                        fill=color+(20,), outline=color+(100,), width=2)
        draw.text((px+20, pill_y+16), title,
                  font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68), fill=color)
        lines_p = body.split("\n")
        for k, ln in enumerate(lines_p):
            draw.text((px+20, pill_y+86+k*34), ln,
                      font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(190,210,230))

    nw_rule_y = pill_y + 210
    draw.line([(x0, nw_rule_y), (W-M, nw_rule_y)], fill=DEEP_RED+(60,), width=2)

    # Final call-to-action statement
    cta_y = nw_rule_y + 28
    cta_font = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 44)
    cta_text = "IMMEDIATE  ·  DEEP  ·  SUSTAINED"
    draw.text((x0, cta_y), cta_text, font=cta_font, fill=AMBER)
    draw.text((x0, cta_y + 56),
              "Emissions reductions across all sectors and scales — essential for a liveable future.",
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=(200,215,230))

    # ── 9. Footer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    footer_y = H - 100
    draw.line([(x0, footer_y), (W-M, footer_y)], fill=(255,255,255,20), width=1)
    draw.text((x0, footer_y + 16),
              "Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.",
              font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 24), fill=(120,150,175))
    draw.text((W - M - 300, footer_y + 16),
              "AR6 · SYR · 2023",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 24), fill=(120,150,175))

    # ── 10. Right-edge vertical text label ───────────────────────────────────
    # Rotate "SYNTHESIS REPORT" vertically on right margin
    label_font = font("BigShoulders-Regular.ttf", 52)
    label_text = "SYNTHESIS  REPORT  AR6"
    label_img = Image.new("RGBA", (600, 40), (0,0,0,0))
    label_draw = ImageDraw.Draw(label_img)
    label_draw.text((0, 0), label_text, font=label_font, fill=(255,255,255,30))
    label_rot = label_img.rotate(90, expand=True)
    lx = W - int(W*0.028) - label_rot.width
    ly = (H - label_rot.height) // 2
    img.paste(label_rot, (lx, ly), label_rot)

    # ── 11. Decorative: concentric arc bottom-right ───────────────────────────
    arc_cx = W - M + 60
    arc_cy = H - M + 60
    for ar in range(8):
        r_arc = 120 + ar * 90
        alpha = max(5, 40 - ar*5)
        # Draw arc manually as series of small lines
        for angle_deg in range(160, 271):
            a = math.radians(angle_deg)
            ax1 = arc_cx + int((r_arc-2)*math.cos(a))
            ay1 = arc_cy + int((r_arc-2)*math.sin(a))
            ax2 = arc_cx + int(r_arc*math.cos(a))
            ay2 = arc_cy + int(r_arc*math.sin(a))
            draw.line([(ax1,ay1),(ax2,ay2)], fill=(255,255,255,alpha))

    # ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    out_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
    img.save(out_path, "PNG", dpi=(DPI, DPI))
    print(f"Saved: {out_path}  ({W}×{H} px)")
    return out_path

if __name__ == "__main__":
    make_poster()

"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Refined Full-Canvas Layout
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
A0 Portrait at 150dpi
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# Palette
NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER      = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION  = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED   = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL       = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM      = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT   = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap_text(draw, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        bb = fnt.getbbox(test)
        if bb[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, fnt, x, y, max_w, fill, line_h=None):
    lines = wrap_text(draw, text, fnt, max_w)
    lh = line_h or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 8)
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += lh
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

M   = int(W * 0.048)   # side margin
TW  = W - 2*M          # text width
x0  = M

# ── Background: fine dot grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 52):
    for gy in range(0, H, 52):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,14))

# ── Left thermal strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
STRIP_W = int(W * 0.013)
for y in range(H):
    t = 1.0 - y/H   # 0=top(hot), 1=bottom(cool)
    if t < 0.33:
        r = int(40  + t/0.33*(TEAL[0]-40))
        g = int(120 + t/0.33*(TEAL[1]-120))
        b = int(115 + t/0.33*(TEAL[2]-115))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt = (t-0.33)/0.33
        r = int(TEAL[0]   + tt*(AMBER[0]-TEAL[0]))
        g = int(TEAL[1]   + tt*(AMBER[1]-TEAL[1]))
        b = int(TEAL[2]   + tt*(AMBER[2]-TEAL[2]))
    else:
        tt = (t-0.66)/0.34
        r = int(AMBER[0]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g = int(AMBER[1]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b = int(AMBER[2]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))

draw.line([(STRIP_W+3,0),(STRIP_W+3,H)], fill=(255,255,255,35), width=2)
x0 = STRIP_W + 3 + M

# ── SECTION HELPER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def section_label(y, text, color=TEAL):
    f = font("Jura-Light.ttf", 34)
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=f, fill=color)
    return y + 52

def hrule(y, opacity=30, color=WHITE, thickness=1, offset_top=0):
    y2 = y + offset_top
    draw.line([(x0, y2),(W-M, y2)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thickness)
    return y2 + thickness + 12

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.007)

# IPCC badge
draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+162, cy+22), "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  AR6  ·  2023",
          font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 38), fill=(170,195,220))
cy += 84

# Main title — enormous
draw.text((x0, cy), "CLIMATE", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 320), fill=WHITE)
cy += 308
draw.text((x0, cy), "CHANGE", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 320), fill=WHITE)
cy += 300

# year + subtitle on same row
draw.text((x0, cy), "2023",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=AMBER)
draw.text((x0+220, cy+18),
          "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 90

cy = hrule(cy, opacity=45, color=WHITE, thickness=1, offset_top=20)
cy = hrule(cy, opacity=60, color=AMBER, thickness=1, offset_top=4)
cy += 30

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE")

# Three metric cards
CARD_H = 260
CARD_GAP = 30
CARD_W = (TW - 2*CARD_GAP) // 3

def metric_card(x, y, cw, ch, value, unit, label, accent):
    draw.rectangle([x,y,x+cw,y+ch], fill=(255,255,255,9), outline=accent+(55,), width=2)
    vf = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140)
    draw.text((x+24, y+10), value, font=vf, fill=accent)
    uf = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
    vbb = vf.getbbox(value)
    draw.text((x+28+vbb[2], y+64), unit, font=uf, fill=accent+(180,))
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
    lines = wrap_text(draw, label, lf, cw-50)
    ly = y + ch - 16 - len(lines)*36
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x+24, ly), ln, font=lf, fill=SLATE_LT)
        ly += 36

metric_card(x0,                   cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "1.1", "°C",
            "Global surface temperature rise (2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900)", AMBER)
metric_card(x0+CARD_W+CARD_GAP,   cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "410", "ppm",
            "Atmospheric CO₂ in 2019 — highest in 2 million years", VERMILION)
metric_card(x0+2*(CARD_W+CARD_GAP),cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "59", "GtCO₂e",
            "Global GHG emissions in 2019", DEEP_RED)
cy += CARD_H + 30

# Secondary indicators strip
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 1901–2018:  +0.20 m        ·        Arctic sea ice (Sept, 1979–2020):  −40% area loss",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=(145,175,210))
cy += 56

cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=14, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "FUTURE PROJECTIONS  ·  SSP SCENARIOS")

# Scenario bar chart
BAR_LABEL_W = int(TW * 0.14)
BAR_GRAPH_W = int(TW * 0.56)
BAR_VAL_W   = int(TW * 0.16)
BAR_DESC_W  = TW - BAR_LABEL_W - BAR_GRAPH_W - BAR_VAL_W
BAR_H = 64
BAR_GAP = 18
MAX_TEMP = 4.4

# Threshold markers header
baseline_px = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.1/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
t15_px      = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.5/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
t20_px      = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(2.0/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)

draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+4, cy-4),
          "PROJECTED WARMING BY 2100  (°C above pre-industrial)",
          font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=(140,170,205))
cy += 40

scenarios = [
    ("SSP1-1.9", 1.4, TEAL,           "Very low emissions · Sustainability focus"),
    ("SSP1-2.6", 1.8, (80,205,185),   "Low emissions"),
    ("SSP2-4.5", 2.7, AMBER,           "Intermediate emissions"),
    ("SSP3-7.0", 3.6, VERMILION,       "High emissions"),
    ("SSP5-8.5", 4.4, DEEP_RED,        "Very high emissions · Fossil-fuel intensive"),
]

bar_top = cy
for i, (name, val, color, desc) in enumerate(scenarios):
    by = cy + i*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)
    # track
    draw.rectangle([x0+BAR_LABEL_W, by+BAR_H//2-2,
                    x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W, by+BAR_H//2+2],
                   fill=(255,255,255,18))
    # bar from baseline (1.1°C) to val
    bx_s = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.1/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
    bx_e = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(val/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
    draw.rectangle([bx_s, by+14, bx_e, by+BAR_H-14], fill=color+(200,))
    # label
    draw.text((x0+4, by+BAR_H//2-18),
              name, font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 34), fill=color)
    # value
    draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W+16, by+BAR_H//2-22),
              f"{val}°C", font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 40), fill=color)
    # desc
    draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W+BAR_VAL_W, by+BAR_H//2-14),
              desc, font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(135,165,200))

bar_bot = cy + len(scenarios)*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)

# 1.5 and 2.0 threshold lines
draw.line([(t15_px, bar_top-8),(t15_px, bar_bot)], fill=TEAL+(160,), width=3)
draw.text((t15_px+5, bar_top-38), "1.5°C", font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
draw.line([(t20_px, bar_top-8),(t20_px, bar_bot)], fill=AMBER+(100,), width=2)
draw.text((t20_px+5, bar_top-38), "2.0°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=AMBER+(150,))

cy = bar_bot + 24

# Sea level note
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 2100:  SSP1-1.9 → 0.28–0.55 m     ·     SSP5-8.5 → 0.63–1.01 m  (continued rise for centuries)",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 29), fill=(135,165,200))
cy += 52

cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=14, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3 — RISKS & IMPACTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "RISKS  ·  VULNERABILITIES  ·  CASCADING IMPACTS")

# Two-column: hero stat left, impact bullets right
COL_SPLIT = int(TW * 0.50)
hero_x = x0
bullet_x = x0 + COL_SPLIT + 60

# HERO: 3.3–3.6 billion
hero_start = cy
draw.text((hero_x, cy), "3.3–3.6",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 260), fill=DEEP_RED)
cy_hero = cy + 248
draw.text((hero_x, cy_hero), "BILLION PEOPLE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108), fill=VERMILION)
cy_hero += 104
draw.text((hero_x, cy_hero), "exposed to severe climate hazards",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy_hero += 64
hero_end = cy_hero

# Right column — impact items
by = hero_start + 10
impacts = [
    ("FOOD",     "Crop yield growth slowing in many regions;\nfisheries productivity declining in tropical zones"),
    ("WATER",    ">50% of global population faces severe\nwater scarcity for at least 1 month per year"),
    ("HEALTH",   "Heat-related mortality rising;\nvector-borne disease ranges expanding"),
    ("BIODIV.",  "Up to 14% of terrestrial species face very\nhigh extinction risk at 1.5°C — rising sharply"),
]
for label, body in impacts:
    draw.text((bullet_x, by), label,
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 36), fill=AMBER)
    by += 42
    lines_b = body.split("\n")
    for ln in lines_b:
        draw.text((bullet_x, by), ln,
                  font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=SLATE_LT)
        by += 38
    by += 28

cy = max(hero_end, by) + 10
cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=20, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "MITIGATION PATHWAYS  ·  ADAPTATION")

mit_top = cy
left_w  = int(TW * 0.44)
right_x = x0 + left_w + 80
right_w = TW - left_w - 80

# LEFT: 43% hero
draw.text((x0, cy), "43%",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 280), fill=AMBER)
cy_left = cy + 268
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "REQUIRED REDUCTION",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86), fill=AMBER)
cy_left += 84
draw.text_wrapped_lines = None  # reset
cy_left = draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "in global GHG emissions by 2030, below 2019 levels — the 1.5°C pathway",
    font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36), x0, cy_left, left_w, SLATE_LT, line_h=46)
cy_left += 30

# Net zero milestones
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2050  for 1.5°C pathway",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=TEAL)
cy_left += 46
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2070  for 2.0°C pathway",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=(90,155,148))
cy_left += 56

# Carbon budget box
cb_h = 80
draw.rectangle([x0, cy_left, x0+left_w, cy_left+cb_h],
               fill=(255,255,255,8), outline=TEAL+(70,), width=2)
draw.text((x0+24, cy_left+16),
          "Remaining carbon budget for 1.5°C (50% chance):",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(140,175,205))
draw.text((x0+24, cy_left+48),

          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
cy_left += cb_h + 20

# 27% note
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "27% reduction by 2030 for 2.0°C pathway",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=(130,160,195))
cy_left += 44

# RIGHT: Key levers
draw.text((right_x, mit_top), "KEY LEVERS",
          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52), fill=SLATE_LT)
ry = mit_top + 70
levers = [
    "Rapid decarbonization of energy systems",
    "Electrification of transport",
    "Demand-side efficiency improvements",
    "Protection & restoration of carbon sinks",
    "Scaled climate finance (3–6× current flows)",
]
for lever in levers:
    draw.ellipse([right_x, ry+14, right_x+12, ry+26], fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((right_x+28, ry), lever,
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=SLATE_LT)

cy = max(cy_left, ry) + 20
cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=20, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5 — NARROWING WINDOW
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "THE NARROWING WINDOW FOR ACTION", color=VERMILION)

# Pull-quote in large italic serif
urg_f = font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 64)
cy = draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "Choices made this decade will determine whether warming is held to 1.5°C or 2°C.",
    urg_f, x0, cy, TW-20, CREAM, line_h=76)
cy += 40

# Three consequence boxes
PIL_W = (TW - 40) // 3
boxes = [
    (DEEP_RED,   "COST",    "Delayed action exponentially\nincreases mitigation costs\nacross all sectors."),
    (VERMILION,  "LOCK-IN", "High-carbon infrastructure\nlock-in reduces future\nfeasibility of limiting warming."),
    (AMBER,      "FINANCE", "Climate finance falls 3–6×\nshort of adaptation needs.\nImmediate scaling required."),

BOX_H = 240
for j,(color,title,body) in enumerate(boxes):
    px = x0 + j*(PIL_W+20)
    draw.rectangle([px, cy, px+PIL_W, cy+BOX_H],
                   fill=color+(18,), outline=color+(100,), width=2)
    draw.text((px+22, cy+16), title,

    lines_b = body.split("\n")
    for k,ln in enumerate(lines_b):

                  font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=SLATE_LT)

cy += BOX_H + 36

# Final CTA rule (double line in red)
draw.line([(x0, cy),(W-M, cy)], fill=DEEP_RED+(90,), width=3)
cy += 8
draw.line([(x0, cy),(W-M, cy)], fill=DEEP_RED+(40,), width=1)

# CTA text
draw.text((x0, cy), "IMMEDIATE  ·  DEEP  ·  SUSTAINED",
          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56), fill=AMBER)
cy += 70

"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Refined Full-Canvas Layout
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
A0 Portrait at 150dpi
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# Palette
NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER      = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION  = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED   = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL       = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM      = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT   = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap_text(draw, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        bb = fnt.getbbox(test)
        if bb[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, fnt, x, y, max_w, fill, line_h=None):
    lines = wrap_text(draw, text, fnt, max_w)
    lh = line_h or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 8)
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += lh
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

M   = int(W * 0.048)   # side margin
TW  = W - 2*M          # text width
x0  = M

# ── Background: fine dot grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 52):
    for gy in range(0, H, 52):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,14))

# ── Left thermal strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
STRIP_W = int(W * 0.013)
for y in range(H):
    t = 1.0 - y/H   # 0=top(hot), 1=bottom(cool)
    if t < 0.33:
        r = int(40  + t/0.33*(TEAL[0]-40))
        g = int(120 + t/0.33*(TEAL[1]-120))
        b = int(115 + t/0.33*(TEAL[2]-115))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt = (t-0.33)/0.33
        r = int(TEAL[0]   + tt*(AMBER[0]-TEAL[0]))
        g = int(TEAL[1]   + tt*(AMBER[1]-TEAL[1]))
        b = int(TEAL[2]   + tt*(AMBER[2]-TEAL[2]))
    else:
        tt = (t-0.66)/0.34
        r = int(AMBER[0]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g = int(AMBER[1]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b = int(AMBER[2]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))

draw.line([(STRIP_W+3,0),(STRIP_W+3,H)], fill=(255,255,255,35), width=2)
x0 = STRIP_W + 3 + M

# ── SECTION HELPER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def section_label(y, text, color=TEAL):
    f = font("Jura-Light.ttf", 34)
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=f, fill=color)
    return y + 52

def hrule(y, opacity=30, color=WHITE, thickness=1, offset_top=0):
    y2 = y + offset_top
    draw.line([(x0, y2),(W-M, y2)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thickness)
    return y2 + thickness + 12

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.007)

# IPCC badge
draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+162, cy+22), "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  AR6  ·  2023",
          font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 38), fill=(170,195,220))
cy += 84

# Main title — enormous
draw.text((x0, cy), "CLIMATE", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 320), fill=WHITE)
cy += 308
draw.text((x0, cy), "CHANGE", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 320), fill=WHITE)
cy += 300

# year + subtitle on same row
draw.text((x0, cy), "2023",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=AMBER)
draw.text((x0+220, cy+18),
          "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 90

cy = hrule(cy, opacity=45, color=WHITE, thickness=1, offset_top=20)
cy = hrule(cy, opacity=60, color=AMBER, thickness=1, offset_top=4)
cy += 30

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE")

# Three metric cards
CARD_H = 260
CARD_GAP = 30
CARD_W = (TW - 2*CARD_GAP) // 3

def metric_card(x, y, cw, ch, value, unit, label, accent):
    draw.rectangle([x,y,x+cw,y+ch], fill=(255,255,255,9), outline=accent+(55,), width=2)
    vf = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140)
    draw.text((x+24, y+10), value, font=vf, fill=accent)
    uf = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
    vbb = vf.getbbox(value)
    draw.text((x+28+vbb[2], y+64), unit, font=uf, fill=accent+(180,))
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
    lines = wrap_text(draw, label, lf, cw-50)
    ly = y + ch - 16 - len(lines)*36
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x+24, ly), ln, font=lf, fill=SLATE_LT)
        ly += 36

metric_card(x0,                   cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "1.1", "°C",
            "Global surface temperature rise (2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900)", AMBER)
metric_card(x0+CARD_W+CARD_GAP,   cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "410", "ppm",
            "Atmospheric CO₂ in 2019 — highest in 2 million years", VERMILION)
metric_card(x0+2*(CARD_W+CARD_GAP),cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "59", "GtCO₂e",
            "Global GHG emissions in 2019", DEEP_RED)
cy += CARD_H + 30

# Secondary indicators strip
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 1901–2018:  +0.20 m        ·        Arctic sea ice (Sept, 1979–2020):  −40% area loss",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=(145,175,210))
cy += 56

cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=14, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "FUTURE PROJECTIONS  ·  SSP SCENARIOS")

# Scenario bar chart
BAR_LABEL_W = int(TW * 0.14)
BAR_GRAPH_W = int(TW * 0.56)
BAR_VAL_W   = int(TW * 0.16)
BAR_DESC_W  = TW - BAR_LABEL_W - BAR_GRAPH_W - BAR_VAL_W
BAR_H = 64
BAR_GAP = 18
MAX_TEMP = 4.4

# Threshold markers header
baseline_px = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.1/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
t15_px      = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.5/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
t20_px      = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(2.0/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)

draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+4, cy-4),
          "PROJECTED WARMING BY 2100  (°C above pre-industrial)",
          font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=(140,170,205))
cy += 40

scenarios = [
    ("SSP1-1.9", 1.4, TEAL,           "Very low emissions · Sustainability focus"),
    ("SSP1-2.6", 1.8, (80,205,185),   "Low emissions"),
    ("SSP2-4.5", 2.7, AMBER,           "Intermediate emissions"),
    ("SSP3-7.0", 3.6, VERMILION,       "High emissions"),
    ("SSP5-8.5", 4.4, DEEP_RED,        "Very high emissions · Fossil-fuel intensive"),
]

bar_top = cy
for i, (name, val, color, desc) in enumerate(scenarios):
    by = cy + i*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)
    # track
    draw.rectangle([x0+BAR_LABEL_W, by+BAR_H//2-2,
                    x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W, by+BAR_H//2+2],
                   fill=(255,255,255,18))
    # bar from baseline (1.1°C) to val
    bx_s = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.1/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
    bx_e = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(val/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
    draw.rectangle([bx_s, by+14, bx_e, by+BAR_H-14], fill=color+(200,))
    # label
    draw.text((x0+4, by+BAR_H//2-18),
              name, font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 34), fill=color)
    # value
    draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W+16, by+BAR_H//2-22),
              f"{val}°C", font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 40), fill=color)
    # desc
    draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W+BAR_VAL_W, by+BAR_H//2-14),
              desc, font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(135,165,200))

bar_bot = cy + len(scenarios)*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)

# 1.5 and 2.0 threshold lines
draw.line([(t15_px, bar_top-8),(t15_px, bar_bot)], fill=TEAL+(160,), width=3)
draw.text((t15_px+5, bar_top-38), "1.5°C", font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
draw.line([(t20_px, bar_top-8),(t20_px, bar_bot)], fill=AMBER+(100,), width=2)
draw.text((t20_px+5, bar_top-38), "2.0°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=AMBER+(150,))

cy = bar_bot + 24

# Sea level note
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 2100:  SSP1-1.9 → 0.28–0.55 m     ·     SSP5-8.5 → 0.63–1.01 m  (continued rise for centuries)",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 29), fill=(135,165,200))
cy += 52

cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=14, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3 — RISKS & IMPACTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "RISKS  ·  VULNERABILITIES  ·  CASCADING IMPACTS")

# Two-column: hero stat left, impact bullets right
COL_SPLIT = int(TW * 0.50)
hero_x = x0
bullet_x = x0 + COL_SPLIT + 60

# HERO: 3.3–3.6 billion
hero_start = cy
draw.text((hero_x, cy), "3.3–3.6",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 260), fill=DEEP_RED)
cy_hero = cy + 248
draw.text((hero_x, cy_hero), "BILLION PEOPLE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108), fill=VERMILION)
cy_hero += 104
draw.text((hero_x, cy_hero), "exposed to severe climate hazards",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy_hero += 64
hero_end = cy_hero

# Right column — impact items
by = hero_start + 10
impacts = [
    ("FOOD",     "Crop yield growth slowing in many regions;\nfisheries productivity declining in tropical zones"),
    ("WATER",    ">50% of global population faces severe\nwater scarcity for at least 1 month per year"),
    ("HEALTH",   "Heat-related mortality rising;\nvector-borne disease ranges expanding"),
    ("BIODIV.",  "Up to 14% of terrestrial species face very\nhigh extinction risk at 1.5°C — rising sharply"),
]
for label, body in impacts:
    draw.text((bullet_x, by), label,
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 36), fill=AMBER)
    by += 42
    lines_b = body.split("\n")
    for ln in lines_b:
        draw.text((bullet_x, by), ln,
                  font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=SLATE_LT)
        by += 38
    by += 28

cy = max(hero_end, by) + 10
cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=20, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4 — MITIGATION & ADAPTATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "MITIGATION PATHWAYS  ·  ADAPTATION")

mit_top = cy
left_w  = int(TW * 0.44)
right_x = x0 + left_w + 80
right_w = TW - left_w - 80

# LEFT: 43% hero
draw.text((x0, cy), "43%",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 280), fill=AMBER)
cy_left = cy + 268
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "REQUIRED REDUCTION",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86), fill=AMBER)
cy_left += 84
draw.text_wrapped_lines = None  # reset
cy_left = draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "in global GHG emissions by 2030, below 2019 levels — the 1.5°C pathway",
    font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36), x0, cy_left, left_w, SLATE_LT, line_h=46)
cy_left += 30

# Net zero milestones
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2050  for 1.5°C pathway",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=TEAL)
cy_left += 46
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2070  for 2.0°C pathway",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=(90,155,148))
cy_left += 56

# Carbon budget box
cb_h = 80
draw.rectangle([x0, cy_left, x0+left_w, cy_left+cb_h],
               fill=(255,255,255,8), outline=TEAL+(70,), width=2)
draw.text((x0+24, cy_left+16),
          "Remaining carbon budget for 1.5°C (50% chance):",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(140,175,205))
draw.text((x0+24, cy_left+48),
          "~500 GtCO₂ from 2020",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
cy_left += cb_h + 20

# 27% note
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "27% reduction by 2030 for 2.0°C pathway",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=(130,160,195))
cy_left += 44

# RIGHT: Key levers
draw.text((right_x, mit_top), "KEY LEVERS",
          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52), fill=SLATE_LT)
ry = mit_top + 70
levers = [
    "Rapid decarbonization of energy systems",
    "Electrification of transport",
    "Demand-side efficiency improvements",
    "Protection & restoration of carbon sinks",
    "Scaled climate finance (3–6× current flows)",
]
for lever in levers:
    draw.ellipse([right_x, ry+14, right_x+12, ry+26], fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((right_x+28, ry), lever,
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=SLATE_LT)
    ry += 56

cy = max(cy_left, ry) + 20
cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=20, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5 — NARROWING WINDOW
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "THE NARROWING WINDOW FOR ACTION", color=VERMILION)

# Pull-quote in large italic serif
urg_f = font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 64)
cy = draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "Choices made this decade will determine whether warming is held to 1.5°C or 2°C.",
    urg_f, x0, cy, TW-20, CREAM, line_h=76)
cy += 40

# Three consequence boxes
PIL_W = (TW - 40) // 3
boxes = [
    (DEEP_RED,   "COST",    "Delayed action exponentially\nincreases mitigation costs\nacross all sectors."),
    (VERMILION,  "LOCK-IN", "High-carbon infrastructure\nlock-in reduces future\nfeasibility of limiting warming."),
    (AMBER,      "FINANCE", "Climate finance falls 3–6×\nshort of adaptation needs.\nImmediate scaling required."),
]
BOX_H = 240
for j,(color,title,body) in enumerate(boxes):
    px = x0 + j*(PIL_W+20)
    draw.rectangle([px, cy, px+PIL_W, cy+BOX_H],
                   fill=color+(18,), outline=color+(100,), width=2)
    draw.text((px+22, cy+16), title,
              font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 84), fill=color)
    lines_b = body.split("\n")
    for k,ln in enumerate(lines_b):
        draw.text((px+22, cy+102+k*40), ln,
                  font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=SLATE_LT)

cy += BOX_H + 36

# Final CTA rule (double line in red)
draw.line([(x0, cy),(W-M, cy)], fill=DEEP_RED+(90,), width=3)
cy += 8
draw.line([(x0, cy),(W-M, cy)], fill=DEEP_RED+(40,), width=1)
cy += 28

# CTA text
draw.text((x0, cy), "IMMEDIATE  ·  DEEP  ·  SUSTAINED",
          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56), fill=AMBER)
cy += 70
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Emissions reductions across all sectors and scales — essential to secure a liveable and sustainable future for all.",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 52

# ── FOOTER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
footer_y = H - 90
draw.line([(x0, footer_y),(W-M, footer_y)], fill=(255,255,255,20), width=1)
draw.text((x0, footer_y+18),
          "Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.",
          font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 26), fill=(110,145,175))
draw.text((W-M-220, footer_y+18), "AR6 · SYR · 2023",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(110,145,175))

# ── Right-edge vertical label ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
lf2 = font("BigShoulders-Regular.ttf", 56)
lbl = "SYNTHESIS REPORT  ·  AR6"
limg = Image.new("RGBA", (700, 44), (0,0,0,0))
ld = ImageDraw.Draw(limg)
ld.text((0,0), lbl, font=lf2, fill=(255,255,255,28))
lrot = limg.rotate(90, expand=True)
img.paste(lrot, (W-lrot.width-8, (H-lrot.height)//2), lrot)

# ── Decorative: concentric arcs bottom-right ──────────────────────────────────
acx, acy = W-M+80, H-M+80
for ar in range(10):
    r_arc = 100 + ar*110
    alpha = max(4, 38-ar*4)
    for ang in range(155, 276, 2):
        a = math.radians(ang)
        ax1 = acx + int((r_arc-3)*math.cos(a))
        ay1 = acy + int((r_arc-3)*math.sin(a))
        ax2 = acx + int(r_arc*math.cos(a))
        ay2 = acy + int(r_arc*math.sin(a))
        draw.line([(ax1,ay1),(ax2,ay2)], fill=(255,255,255,alpha))

# ── Top-right decorative: temperature scale legend ───────────────────────────
leg_x = W - M - 280
leg_y = int(H * 0.007) + 10
leg_h = 320
