"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Refined Full-Canvas Layout
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
A0 Portrait at 150dpi
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# Palette
NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER      = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION  = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED   = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL       = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM      = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT   = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap_text(draw, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        bb = fnt.getbbox(test)
        if bb[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, fnt, x, y, max_w, fill, line_h=None):
    lines = wrap_text(draw, text, fnt, max_w)
    lh = line_h or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 8)
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += lh
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

M   = int(W * 0.048)   # side margin
TW  = W - 2*M          # text width
x0  = M

# ── Background: fine dot grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 52):
    for gy in range(0, H, 52):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,14))

# ── Left thermal strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
STRIP_W = int(W * 0.013)
for y in range(H):
    t = 1.0 - y/H   # 0=top(hot), 1=bottom(cool)
    if t < 0.33:
        r = int(40  + t/0.33*(TEAL[0]-40))
        g = int(120 + t/0.33*(TEAL[1]-120))
        b = int(115 + t/0.33*(TEAL[2]-115))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt = (t-0.33)/0.33
        r = int(TEAL[0]   + tt*(AMBER[0]-TEAL[0]))
        g = int(TEAL[1]   + tt*(AMBER[1]-TEAL[1]))
        b = int(TEAL[2]   + tt*(AMBER[2]-TEAL[2]))
    else:
        tt = (t-0.66)/0.34
        r = int(AMBER[0]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g = int(AMBER[1]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b = int(AMBER[2]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))

draw.line([(STRIP_W+3,0),(STRIP_W+3,H)], fill=(255,255,255,35), width=2)
x0 = STRIP_W + 3 + M

# ── SECTION HELPER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def section_label(y, text, color=TEAL):
    f = font("Jura-Light.ttf", 34)
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=f, fill=color)
    return y + 52

def hrule(y, opacity=30, color=WHITE, thickness=1, offset_top=0):
    y2 = y + offset_top
    draw.line([(x0, y2),(W-M, y2)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thickness)
    return y2 + thickness + 12

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.007)

# IPCC badge
draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+162, cy+22), "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  AR6  ·  2023",
          font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 38), fill=(170,195,220))
cy += 84

# Main title — enormous
draw.text((x0, cy), "CLIMATE", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 320), fill=WHITE)
cy += 308
draw.text((x0, cy), "CHANGE", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 320), fill=WHITE)
cy += 300

# year + subtitle on same row
draw.text((x0, cy), "2023",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=AMBER)
draw.text((x0+220, cy+18),
          "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 90

cy = hrule(cy, opacity=45, color=WHITE, thickness=1, offset_top=20)
cy = hrule(cy, opacity=60, color=AMBER, thickness=1, offset_top=4)
cy += 30

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE")

# Three metric cards
CARD_H = 260
CARD_GAP = 30
CARD_W = (TW - 2*CARD_GAP) // 3

def metric_card(x, y, cw, ch, value, unit, label, accent):
    draw.rectangle([x,y,x+cw,y+ch], fill=(255,255,255,9), outline=accent+(55,), width=2)
    vf = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140)
    draw.text((x+24, y+10), value, font=vf, fill=accent)
    uf = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
    vbb = vf.getbbox(value)
    draw.text((x+28+vbb[2], y+64), unit, font=uf, fill=accent+(180,))
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
    lines = wrap_text(draw, label, lf, cw-50)
    ly = y + ch - 16 - len(lines)*36
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x+24, ly), ln, font=lf, fill=SLATE_LT)
        ly += 36

metric_card(x0,                   cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "1.1", "°C",
            "Global surface temperature rise (2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900)", AMBER)
metric_card(x0+CARD_W+CARD_GAP,   cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "410", "ppm",
            "Atmospheric CO₂ in 2019 — highest in 2 million years", VERMILION)
metric_card(x0+2*(CARD_W+CARD_GAP),cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "59", "GtCO₂e",
            "Global GHG emissions in 2019", DEEP_RED)
cy += CARD_H + 30

# Secondary indicators strip
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 1901–2018:  +0.20 m        ·        Arctic sea ice (Sept, 1979–2020):  −40% area loss",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=(145,175,210))
cy += 56

cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=14, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "FUTURE PROJECTIONS  ·  SSP SCENARIOS")

# Scenario bar chart
BAR_LABEL_W = int(TW * 0.14)
BAR_GRAPH_W = int(TW * 0.56)
BAR_VAL_W   = int(TW * 0.16)
BAR_DESC_W  = TW - BAR_LABEL_W - BAR_GRAPH_W - BAR_VAL_W
BAR_H = 64
BAR_GAP = 18
MAX_TEMP = 4.4

# Threshold markers header
baseline_px = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.1/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
t15_px      = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.5/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
t20_px      = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(2.0/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)

draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+4, cy-4),
          "PROJECTED WARMING BY 2100  (°C above pre-industrial)",
          font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=(140,170,205))
cy += 40

scenarios = [
    ("SSP1-1.9", 1.4, TEAL,           "Very low emissions · Sustainability focus"),
    ("SSP1-2.6", 1.8, (80,205,185),   "Low emissions"),
    ("SSP2-4.5", 2.7, AMBER,           "Intermediate emissions"),
    ("SSP3-7.0", 3.6, VERMILION,       "High emissions"),
    ("SSP5-8.5", 4.4, DEEP_RED,        "Very high emissions · Fossil-fuel intensive"),
]

bar_top = cy
for i, (name, val, color, desc) in enumerate(scenarios):
    by = cy + i*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)
    # track
    draw.rectangle([x0+BAR_LABEL_W, by+BAR_H//2-2,
                    x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W, by+BAR_H//2+2],
                   fill=(255,255,255,18))
    # bar from baseline (1.1°C) to val
    bx_s = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.1/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
    bx_e = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(val/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
    draw.rectangle([bx_s, by+14, bx_e, by+BAR_H-14], fill=color+(200,))
    # label
    draw.text((x0+4, by+BAR_H//2-18),
              name, font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 34), fill=color)
    # value
    draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W+16, by+BAR_H//2-22),
              f"{val}°C", font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 40), fill=color)
    # desc
    draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W+BAR_VAL_W, by+BAR_H//2-14),
              desc, font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(135,165,200))

bar_bot = cy + len(scenarios)*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)

# 1.5 and 2.0 threshold lines
draw.line([(t15_px, bar_top-8),(t15_px, bar_bot)], fill=TEAL+(160,), width=3)
draw.text((t15_px+5, bar_top-38), "1.5°C", font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
draw.line([(t20_px, bar_top-8),(t20_px, bar_bot)], fill=AMBER+(100,), width=2)
draw.text((t20_px+5, bar_top-38), "2.0°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=AMBER+(150,))

cy = bar_bot + 24

# Sea level note
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 2100:  SSP1-1.9 → 0.28–0.55 m     ·     SSP5-8.5 → 0.63–1.01 m  (continued rise for centuries)",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 29), fill=(135,165,200))
cy += 52

cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=14, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3 — RISKS & IMPACTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "RISKS  ·  VULNERABILITIES  ·  CASCADING IMPACTS")

# Two-column: hero stat left, impact bullets right
COL_SPLIT = int(TW * 0.50)
hero_x = x0
bullet_x = x0 + COL_SPLIT + 60

# HERO: 3.3–3.6 billion
hero_start = cy
draw.text((hero_x, cy), "3.3–3.6",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 260), fill=DEEP_RED)
cy_hero = cy + 248
draw.text((hero_x, cy_hero), "BILLION PEOPLE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108), fill=VERMILION)
cy_hero += 104
draw.text((hero_x, cy_hero), "exposed to severe climate hazards",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy_hero += 64
hero_end = cy_hero

# Right column — impact items
by = hero_start + 10
impacts = [
    ("FOOD",     "Crop yield growth slowing in many regions;\nfisheries productivity declining in tropical zones"),
    ("WATER",    ">50% of global population faces severe\nwater scarcity for at least 1 month per year"),
    ("HEALTH",   "Heat-related mortality rising;\nvector-borne disease ranges expanding"),
    ("BIODIV.",  "Up to 14% of terrestrial species face very\nhigh extinction risk at 1.5°C — rising sharply"),
]
for label, body in impacts:
    draw.text((bullet_x, by), label,
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 36), fill=AMBER)
    by += 42
    lines_b = body.split("\n")
    for ln in lines_b:
        draw.text((bullet_x, by), ln,
                  font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=SLATE_LT)
        by += 38
    by += 28

cy = max(hero_end, by) + 10
cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=20, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4 — MITIGATION & ADAPTATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "MITIGATION PATHWAYS  ·  ADAPTATION")

mit_top = cy
left_w  = int(TW * 0.44)
right_x = x0 + left_w + 80
right_w = TW - left_w - 80

# LEFT: 43% hero
draw.text((x0, cy), "43%",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 280), fill=AMBER)
cy_left = cy + 268
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "REQUIRED REDUCTION",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86), fill=AMBER)
cy_left += 84
draw.text_wrapped_lines = None  # reset
cy_left = draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "in global GHG emissions by 2030, below 2019 levels — the 1.5°C pathway",
    font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36), x0, cy_left, left_w, SLATE_LT, line_h=46)
cy_left += 30

# Net zero milestones
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2050  for 1.5°C pathway",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=TEAL)
cy_left += 46
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2070  for 2.0°C pathway",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=(90,155,148))
cy_left += 56

# Carbon budget box
cb_h = 80
draw.rectangle([x0, cy_left, x0+left_w, cy_left+cb_h],
               fill=(255,255,255,8), outline=TEAL+(70,), width=2)
draw.text((x0+24, cy_left+16),
          "Remaining carbon budget for 1.5°C (50% chance):",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(140,175,205))
draw.text((x0+24, cy_left+48),
          "~500 GtCO₂ from 2020",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
cy_left += cb_h + 20

# 27% note
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "27% reduction by 2030 for 2.0°C pathway",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=(130,160,195))
cy_left += 44

# RIGHT: Key levers
draw.text((right_x, mit_top), "KEY LEVERS",
          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52), fill=SLATE_LT)
ry = mit_top + 70
levers = [
    "Rapid decarbonization of energy systems",
    "Electrification of transport",
    "Demand-side efficiency improvements",
    "Protection & restoration of carbon sinks",
    "Scaled climate finance (3–6× current flows)",
]
for lever in levers:
    draw.ellipse([right_x, ry+14, right_x+12, ry+26], fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((right_x+28, ry), lever,
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=SLATE_LT)
    ry += 56

cy = max(cy_left, ry) + 20
cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=20, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5 — NARROWING WINDOW
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "THE NARROWING WINDOW FOR ACTION", color=VERMILION)

# Pull-quote in large italic serif
urg_f = font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 64)
cy = draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "Choices made this decade will determine whether warming is held to 1.5°C or 2°C.",
    urg_f, x0, cy, TW-20, CREAM, line_h=76)
cy += 40

# Three consequence boxes
PIL_W = (TW - 40) // 3
boxes = [
    (DEEP_RED,   "COST",    "Delayed action exponentially\nincreases mitigation costs\nacross all sectors."),
    (VERMILION,  "LOCK-IN", "High-carbon infrastructure\nlock-in reduces future\nfeasibility of limiting warming."),
    (AMBER,      "FINANCE", "Climate finance falls 3–6×\nshort of adaptation needs.\nImmediate scaling required."),
]
BOX_H = 240
for j,(color,title,body) in enumerate(boxes):
    px = x0 + j*(PIL_W+20)
    draw.rectangle([px, cy, px+PIL_W, cy+BOX_H],

    draw.text((px+22, cy+16), title,
              font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 84), fill=color)

cy += 8
draw.line([(x0, cy),(W-M, cy)], fill=DEEP_RED+(40,), width=1)
cy += 28

# CTA text
draw.text((x0, cy), "IMMEDIATE  ·  DEEP  ·  SUSTAINED",
          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56), fill=AMBER)
cy += 70
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Emissions reductions across all sectors and scales — essential to secure a liveable and sustainable future for all.",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 52

footer_y = H - 90
draw.line([(x0, footer_y),(W-M, footer_y)], fill=(255,255,255,20), width=1)
draw.text((x0, footer_y+18),
          "Source: IPCC, 2023. AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.",
          font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 26), fill=(110,145,175))
draw.text((W-M-220, footer_y+18), "AR6 · SYR · 2023",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(110,145,175))

# ── Right-edge vertical label ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
lf2 = font("BigShoulders-Regular.ttf", 56)
lbl = "SYNTHESIS REPORT  ·  AR6"
limg = Image.new("RGBA", (700, 44), (0,0,0,0))
ld = ImageDraw.Draw(limg)
ld.text((0,0), lbl, font=lf2, fill=(255,255,255,28))
lrot = limg.rotate(90, expand=True)
img.paste(lrot, (W-lrot.width-8, (H-lrot.height)//2), lrot)

# ── Decorative: concentric arcs bottom-right ──────────────────────────────────
acx, acy = W-M+80, H-M+80
for ar in range(10):
    r_arc = 100 + ar*110
    alpha = max(4, 38-ar*4)
    for ang in range(155, 276, 2):
        a = math.radians(ang)
        ax1 = acx + int((r_arc-3)*math.cos(a))
        ay1 = acy + int((r_arc-3)*math.sin(a))
        ax2 = acx + int(r_arc*math.cos(a))
        ay2 = acy + int(r_arc*math.sin(a))
        draw.line([(ax1,ay1),(ax2,ay2)], fill=(255,255,255,alpha))

# ── Top-right decorative: temperature scale legend ───────────────────────────
leg_x = W - M - 280
leg_y = int(H * 0.007) + 10
leg_h = 320
leg_w = 28
for y_i in range(leg_h):
    t = y_i / leg_h
    # top=hot, bottom=cool
    if t < 0.33:
        r = int(DEEP_RED[0] + t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g = int(DEEP_RED[1] + t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b = int(DEEP_RED[2] + t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(leg_x,leg_y+y_i),(leg_x+leg_w,leg_y+y_i)], fill=(r,g,b))
draw.rectangle([leg_x,leg_y,leg_x+leg_w,leg_y+leg_h], outline=(255,255,255,40), width=1)
draw.text((leg_x+leg_w+10, leg_y),     "4.4°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf",24), fill=(160,15,15))
draw.text((leg_x+leg_w+10, leg_y+leg_h-20), "1.1°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf",24), fill=TEAL)

# ── Check layout fits ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(f"Last content y: {cy}  Canvas H: {H}  ({cy/H*100:.1f}% used)")

out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(DPI,DPI))
print(f"Saved: {out}  ({W}×{H})")

"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Refined Full-Canvas Layout
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
A0 Portrait at 150dpi
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

# Palette
NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER      = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION  = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED   = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL       = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM      = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT   = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap_text(draw, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        bb = fnt.getbbox(test)
        if bb[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, fnt, x, y, max_w, fill, line_h=None):
    lines = wrap_text(draw, text, fnt, max_w)
    lh = line_h or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 8)
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += lh
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

M   = int(W * 0.048)   # side margin
TW  = W - 2*M          # text width
x0  = M

# ── Background: fine dot grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 52):
    for gy in range(0, H, 52):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,14))

# ── Left thermal strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
STRIP_W = int(W * 0.013)
for y in range(H):
    t = 1.0 - y/H   # 0=top(hot), 1=bottom(cool)
    if t < 0.33:
        r = int(40  + t/0.33*(TEAL[0]-40))
        g = int(120 + t/0.33*(TEAL[1]-120))
        b = int(115 + t/0.33*(TEAL[2]-115))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt = (t-0.33)/0.33
        r = int(TEAL[0]   + tt*(AMBER[0]-TEAL[0]))
        g = int(TEAL[1]   + tt*(AMBER[1]-TEAL[1]))
        b = int(TEAL[2]   + tt*(AMBER[2]-TEAL[2]))
    else:
        tt = (t-0.66)/0.34
        r = int(AMBER[0]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g = int(AMBER[1]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b = int(AMBER[2]  + tt*(DEEP_RED[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))

draw.line([(STRIP_W+3,0),(STRIP_W+3,H)], fill=(255,255,255,35), width=2)
x0 = STRIP_W + 3 + M

# ── SECTION HELPER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def section_label(y, text, color=TEAL):
    f = font("Jura-Light.ttf", 34)
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=f, fill=color)
    return y + 52

def hrule(y, opacity=30, color=WHITE, thickness=1, offset_top=0):
    y2 = y + offset_top
    draw.line([(x0, y2),(W-M, y2)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thickness)
    return y2 + thickness + 12

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.007)

# IPCC badge
draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+162, cy+22), "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  AR6  ·  2023",
          font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 38), fill=(170,195,220))
cy += 84

# Main title — enormous
draw.text((x0, cy), "CLIMATE", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 320), fill=WHITE)
cy += 308
draw.text((x0, cy), "CHANGE", font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 320), fill=WHITE)
cy += 300

# year + subtitle on same row
draw.text((x0, cy), "2023",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 72), fill=AMBER)
draw.text((x0+220, cy+18),
          "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 90

cy = hrule(cy, opacity=45, color=WHITE, thickness=1, offset_top=20)
cy = hrule(cy, opacity=60, color=AMBER, thickness=1, offset_top=4)
cy += 30

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — OBSERVED CHANGES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE")

# Three metric cards
CARD_H = 260
CARD_GAP = 30
CARD_W = (TW - 2*CARD_GAP) // 3

def metric_card(x, y, cw, ch, value, unit, label, accent):
    draw.rectangle([x,y,x+cw,y+ch], fill=(255,255,255,9), outline=accent+(55,), width=2)
    vf = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140)
    draw.text((x+24, y+10), value, font=vf, fill=accent)
    uf = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
    vbb = vf.getbbox(value)
    draw.text((x+28+vbb[2], y+64), unit, font=uf, fill=accent+(180,))
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
    lines = wrap_text(draw, label, lf, cw-50)
    ly = y + ch - 16 - len(lines)*36
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x+24, ly), ln, font=lf, fill=SLATE_LT)
        ly += 36

metric_card(x0,                   cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "1.1", "°C",
            "Global surface temperature rise (2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900)", AMBER)
metric_card(x0+CARD_W+CARD_GAP,   cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "410", "ppm",
            "Atmospheric CO₂ in 2019 — highest in 2 million years", VERMILION)
metric_card(x0+2*(CARD_W+CARD_GAP),cy, CARD_W, CARD_H,
            "59", "GtCO₂e",
            "Global GHG emissions in 2019", DEEP_RED)
cy += CARD_H + 30

# Secondary indicators strip
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 1901–2018:  +0.20 m        ·        Arctic sea ice (Sept, 1979–2020):  −40% area loss",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=(145,175,210))
cy += 56

cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=14, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "FUTURE PROJECTIONS  ·  SSP SCENARIOS")

# Scenario bar chart
BAR_LABEL_W = int(TW * 0.14)
BAR_GRAPH_W = int(TW * 0.56)
BAR_VAL_W   = int(TW * 0.16)
BAR_DESC_W  = TW - BAR_LABEL_W - BAR_GRAPH_W - BAR_VAL_W
BAR_H = 64
BAR_GAP = 18
MAX_TEMP = 4.4

# Threshold markers header
baseline_px = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.1/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
t15_px      = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.5/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
t20_px      = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(2.0/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)

draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+4, cy-4),
          "PROJECTED WARMING BY 2100  (°C above pre-industrial)",
          font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=(140,170,205))
cy += 40

scenarios = [
    ("SSP1-1.9", 1.4, TEAL,           "Very low emissions · Sustainability focus"),
    ("SSP1-2.6", 1.8, (80,205,185),   "Low emissions"),
    ("SSP2-4.5", 2.7, AMBER,           "Intermediate emissions"),
    ("SSP3-7.0", 3.6, VERMILION,       "High emissions"),
    ("SSP5-8.5", 4.4, DEEP_RED,        "Very high emissions · Fossil-fuel intensive"),
]

bar_top = cy
for i, (name, val, color, desc) in enumerate(scenarios):
    by = cy + i*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)
    # track
    draw.rectangle([x0+BAR_LABEL_W, by+BAR_H//2-2,
                    x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W, by+BAR_H//2+2],
                   fill=(255,255,255,18))
    # bar from baseline (1.1°C) to val
    bx_s = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(1.1/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
    bx_e = x0 + BAR_LABEL_W + int(val/MAX_TEMP*BAR_GRAPH_W)
    draw.rectangle([bx_s, by+14, bx_e, by+BAR_H-14], fill=color+(200,))
    # label
    draw.text((x0+4, by+BAR_H//2-18),
              name, font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 34), fill=color)
    # value
    draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W+16, by+BAR_H//2-22),
              f"{val}°C", font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 40), fill=color)
    # desc
    draw.text((x0+BAR_LABEL_W+BAR_GRAPH_W+BAR_VAL_W, by+BAR_H//2-14),
              desc, font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26), fill=(135,165,200))

bar_bot = cy + len(scenarios)*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)

# 1.5 and 2.0 threshold lines
draw.line([(t15_px, bar_top-8),(t15_px, bar_bot)], fill=TEAL+(160,), width=3)
draw.text((t15_px+5, bar_top-38), "1.5°C", font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 30), fill=TEAL)
draw.line([(t20_px, bar_top-8),(t20_px, bar_bot)], fill=AMBER+(100,), width=2)
draw.text((t20_px+5, bar_top-38), "2.0°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=AMBER+(150,))

cy = bar_bot + 24

# Sea level note
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 2100:  SSP1-1.9 → 0.28–0.55 m     ·     SSP5-8.5 → 0.63–1.01 m  (continued rise for centuries)",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 29), fill=(135,165,200))
cy += 52

cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=14, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3 — RISKS & IMPACTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "RISKS  ·  VULNERABILITIES  ·  CASCADING IMPACTS")

# Two-column: hero stat left, impact bullets right
COL_SPLIT = int(TW * 0.50)
hero_x = x0
bullet_x = x0 + COL_SPLIT + 60

# HERO: 3.3–3.6 billion
hero_start = cy
draw.text((hero_x, cy), "3.3–3.6",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 260), fill=DEEP_RED)
cy_hero = cy + 248
draw.text((hero_x, cy_hero), "BILLION PEOPLE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108), fill=VERMILION)
cy_hero += 104
draw.text((hero_x, cy_hero), "exposed to severe climate hazards",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy_hero += 64
hero_end = cy_hero

# Right column — impact items
by = hero_start + 10
impacts = [
    ("FOOD",     "Crop yield growth slowing in many regions;\nfisheries productivity declining in tropical zones"),
    ("WATER",    ">50% of global population faces severe\nwater scarcity for at least 1 month per year"),
    ("HEALTH",   "Heat-related mortality rising;\nvector-borne disease ranges expanding"),
    ("BIODIV.",  "Up to 14% of terrestrial species face very\nhigh extinction risk at 1.5°C — rising sharply"),
]
for label, body in impacts:
    draw.text((bullet_x, by), label,
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 36), fill=AMBER)
    by += 42
    lines_b = body.split("\n")
    for ln in lines_b:
        draw.text((bullet_x, by), ln,
                  font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=SLATE_LT)
        by += 38
    by += 28

cy = max(hero_end, by) + 10
cy = hrule(cy, offset_top=20, opacity=25)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4 — MITIGATION & ADAPTATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = section_label(cy, "MITIGATION PATHWAYS  ·  ADAPTATION")

mit_top = cy
left_w  = int(TW * 0.44)
right_x = x0 + left_w + 80
right_w = TW - left_w - 80

# LEFT: 43% hero
draw.text((x0, cy), "43%",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 280), fill=AMBER)
cy_left = cy + 268
draw.text((x0, cy_left), "REQUIRED REDUCTION",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86), fill=AMBER)
cy_left += 84
draw.text_wrapped_lines = None  # reset
cy_left = draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "in global GHG emissions by 2030, below 2019 levels — the 1.5°C pathway",
    font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 36), x0, cy_left, left_w, SLATE_LT, line_h=46)
cy_left += 30

TEAL       = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM      = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT   = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(draw, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(draw, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        return y + (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40) + 6
    lines = wrap(draw, text, fnt, max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 10)
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += step
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

M = int(W * 0.048)
x0 = STRIP_W + 4 + M

for gx in range(0, W, 54):

# ── Left thermal gradient strip ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for y in range(H):

    if t < 0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))

    return y + thick + gap

"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Full A0 Canvas
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
Target: fill the full A0 canvas with authoritative, data-forward design
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER      = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION  = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED   = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL       = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM      = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT   = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(draw, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(draw, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        return y + (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40) + 6
    lines = wrap(draw, text, fnt, max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 10)
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += step
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

STRIP_W = int(W * 0.014)
M = int(W * 0.048)
x0 = STRIP_W + 4 + M
TW = W - M - x0

# ── Background dots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 54):
    for gy in range(0, H, 54):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,13))

# ── Left thermal gradient strip ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for y in range(H):
    t = y / H   # 0=top, 1=bottom
    if t < 0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))
draw.line([(STRIP_W+2,0),(STRIP_W+2,H)], fill=(255,255,255,40), width=2)

def hrule(y, color=WHITE, opacity=28, thick=1, gap=24):
    draw.line([(x0,y),(W-M,y)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thick)
    return y + thick + gap

def sec_header(y, text, color=TEAL, gap_after=56):
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 38), fill=color)
    return y + gap_after

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER  (~14% of canvas)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.009)

draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+182, cy+24),
          "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  AR6  ·  2023",
          font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 42), fill=(168,195,220))
cy += 94

draw.text((x0, cy), "CLIMATE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 420), fill=WHITE)
cy += 402
draw.text((x0, cy), "CHANGE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 420), fill=WHITE)
cy += 390

draw.text((x0, cy), "2023",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 86), fill=AMBER)
draw.text((x0+240, cy+22),
          "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 50), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 102

cy = hrule(cy, color=WHITE, opacity=40, thick=2, gap=8)
cy = hrule(cy, color=AMBER,  opacity=55, thick=1, gap=38)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — OBSERVED CHANGES  (~14%)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_header(cy, "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE", gap_after=56)

# Three cards
CARD_H = 320
GAP    = 36
CW     = (TW - 2*GAP) // 3

def card(x, y, cw, ch, val, unit, label, accent):
    draw.rectangle([x,y,x+cw,y+ch], fill=(255,255,255,9), outline=accent+(55,), width=2)
    vf = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 176)
    draw.text((x+28, y+12), val, font=vf, fill=accent)
    uf = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 40)
    draw.text((x+32+vf.getbbox(val)[2], y+80), unit, font=uf, fill=accent+(180,))
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
    ly = y + ch - 20 - len(wrap(draw, label, lf, cw-56))*38
    for ln in wrap(draw, label, lf, cw-56):

"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Full A0 Canvas
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
Target: fill the full A0 canvas with authoritative, data-forward design
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER      = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION  = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED   = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL       = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM      = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT   = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(draw, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(draw, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        return y + (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40) + 6
    lines = wrap(draw, text, fnt, max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 10)
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += step
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

STRIP_W = int(W * 0.014)
M = int(W * 0.048)
x0 = STRIP_W + 4 + M
TW = W - M - x0

# ── Background dots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 54):
    for gy in range(0, H, 54):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,13))

# ── Left thermal gradient strip ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for y in range(H):
    t = y / H   # 0=top, 1=bottom
    if t < 0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))
draw.line([(STRIP_W+2,0),(STRIP_W+2,H)], fill=(255,255,255,40), width=2)

def hrule(y, color=WHITE, opacity=28, thick=1, gap=24):
    draw.line([(x0,y),(W-M,y)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thick)
    return y + thick + gap

def sec_header(y, text, color=TEAL, gap_after=56):
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 38), fill=color)
    return y + gap_after

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER  (~14% of canvas)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.009)

draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+182, cy+24),
          "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  AR6  ·  2023",
          font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 42), fill=(168,195,220))
cy += 94

draw.text((x0, cy), "CLIMATE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 420), fill=WHITE)
cy += 402
draw.text((x0, cy), "CHANGE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 420), fill=WHITE)
cy += 390

draw.text((x0, cy), "2023",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 86), fill=AMBER)
draw.text((x0+240, cy+22),
          "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 50), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 102

cy = hrule(cy, color=WHITE, opacity=40, thick=2, gap=8)
cy = hrule(cy, color=AMBER,  opacity=55, thick=1, gap=38)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — OBSERVED CHANGES  (~14%)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_header(cy, "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE", gap_after=56)

# Three cards
CARD_H = 320
GAP    = 36
CW     = (TW - 2*GAP) // 3

def card(x, y, cw, ch, val, unit, label, accent):
    draw.rectangle([x,y,x+cw,y+ch], fill=(255,255,255,9), outline=accent+(55,), width=2)
    vf = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 176)
    draw.text((x+28, y+12), val, font=vf, fill=accent)
    uf = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 40)
    draw.text((x+32+vf.getbbox(val)[2], y+80), unit, font=uf, fill=accent+(180,))
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
    ly = y + ch - 20 - len(wrap(draw, label, lf, cw-56))*38
    for ln in wrap(draw, label, lf, cw-56):
        draw.text((x+28, ly), ln, font=lf, fill=SLATE_LT); ly += 38

card(x0,             cy, CW, CARD_H, "1.1","°C",
     "Global surface temperature rise (2011–2020 vs. pre-industrial 1850–1900)", AMBER)
card(x0+CW+GAP,      cy, CW, CARD_H, "410","ppm",
     "Atmospheric CO₂ in 2019 — highest in at least 2 million years", VERMILION)
card(x0+2*(CW+GAP),  cy, CW, CARD_H, "59","GtCO₂e",
     "Global GHG emissions in 2019", DEEP_RED)
cy += CARD_H + 36

draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise 1901–2018:  +0.20 m        ·        Arctic sea ice (Sept, 1979–2020):  −40% area loss",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=(145,175,210))
cy += 66
cy = hrule(cy, gap=30)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS  (~15%)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_header(cy, "FUTURE PROJECTIONS  ·  SSP SCENARIOS", gap_after=50)

BLW  = int(TW * 0.14)
BGW  = int(TW * 0.52)
BVLW = 160
BDEW = TW - BLW - BGW - BVLW
BAR_H  = 78
BAR_GAP = 22
MAX_T  = 4.4

draw.text((x0+BLW+4, cy-6),
          "PROJECTED WARMING BY 2100  (°C above pre-industrial baseline)",
          font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 30), fill=(135,168,205))
cy += 44

scenarios = [
    ("SSP1-1.9", 1.4, TEAL,          "Very low emissions · Sustainability focus"),
    ("SSP1-2.6", 1.8, (78,205,185),  "Low emissions"),
    ("SSP2-4.5", 2.7, AMBER,          "Intermediate emissions"),
    ("SSP3-7.0", 3.6, VERMILION,      "High emissions"),
    ("SSP5-8.5", 4.4, DEEP_RED,       "Very high emissions · Fossil-fuel intensive"),
]
bar_top = cy
t15_x = x0+BLW+int(1.5/MAX_T*BGW)
t20_x = x0+BLW+int(2.0/MAX_T*BGW)
b11_x = x0+BLW+int(1.1/MAX_T*BGW)

for i,(name,val,color,desc) in enumerate(scenarios):
    by = cy + i*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)
    draw.rectangle([x0+BLW, by+BAR_H//2-2, x0+BLW+BGW, by+BAR_H//2+2],
                   fill=(255,255,255,16))
    draw.rectangle([b11_x, by+16, x0+BLW+int(val/MAX_T*BGW), by+BAR_H-16],
                   fill=color+(205,))
    draw.text((x0+4, by+BAR_H//2-20), name,
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 38), fill=color)
    draw.text((x0+BLW+BGW+14, by+BAR_H//2-24), f"{val}°C",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 46), fill=color)
    draw.text((x0+BLW+BGW+BVLW, by+BAR_H//2-16), desc,
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(132,163,198))

bar_bot = cy + len(scenarios)*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)
draw.line([(t15_x,bar_top-10),(t15_x,bar_bot)], fill=TEAL+(165,), width=3)
draw.text((t15_x+6, bar_top-42),"1.5°C", font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf",32), fill=TEAL)
draw.line([(t20_x,bar_top-10),(t20_x,bar_bot)], fill=AMBER+(105,), width=2)
draw.text((t20_x+6, bar_top-42),"2.0°C", font=font("Jura-Light.ttf",30), fill=AMBER+(155,))

cy = bar_bot + 28
draw.text((x0, cy),
          "Sea level rise by 2100:  SSP1-1.9 → 0.28–0.55 m     ·     SSP5-8.5 → 0.63–1.01 m  (continued rise for centuries to millennia)",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=(132,163,198))
cy += 60
cy = hrule(cy, gap=30)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3 — RISKS & IMPACTS  (~17%)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_header(cy, "RISKS  ·  VULNERABILITIES  ·  CASCADING IMPACTS", gap_after=52)

COL_SPLIT = int(TW * 0.50)
bullet_x  = x0 + COL_SPLIT + 80
bullet_w  = TW - COL_SPLIT - 80

hero_start = cy
draw.text((x0, cy), "3.3–3.6",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 340), fill=DEEP_RED)
cy_l = cy + 328
draw.text((x0, cy_l), "BILLION PEOPLE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 138), fill=VERMILION)
cy_l += 134
draw.text((x0, cy_l), "exposed to severe climate hazards",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 48), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy_l += 68

# Right bullets
ry = hero_start + 8
impacts = [
    ("FOOD",     "Crop yield growth slowing; fisheries\nproductivity declining in tropical zones"),
    ("WATER",    ">50% of global population faces\nsevere water scarcity ≥1 month/year"),
    ("HEALTH",   "Heat-related mortality rising;\nvector-borne disease ranges expanding"),
    ("BIODIV.",  "Up to 14% of terrestrial species face\nhigh extinction risk at 1.5°C warming"),
]
for label, body in impacts:
    draw.text((bullet_x, ry), label,
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 40), fill=AMBER)
    ry += 50
    for ln in body.split("\n"):
        draw.text((bullet_x, ry), ln,
                  font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32), fill=SLATE_LT)
        ry += 42
    ry += 34

cy = max(cy_l, ry) + 20
cy = hrule(cy, gap=30)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_header(cy, "MITIGATION PATHWAYS  ·  ADAPTATION", gap_after=52)

left_w  = int(TW * 0.46)
right_x = x0 + left_w + 90
right_w = TW - left_w - 90

mit_top = cy
# 43% hero
draw.text((x0, cy), "43%",

cy_l = cy + 348
draw.text((x0, cy_l), "REQUIRED REDUCTION",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108), fill=AMBER)
cy_l += 106
cy_l = put(draw,

cy_l += 36

draw.text((x0, cy_l), "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2050  for 1.5°C pathway",

draw.text((x0, cy_l), "Net zero CO₂  →  ~2070  for 2.0°C pathway",

cb_h = 98
draw.rectangle([x0, cy_l, x0+left_w, cy_l+cb_h], fill=(255,255,255,8), outline=TEAL+(70,), width=2)
draw.text((x0+28, cy_l+14), "Remaining carbon budget for 1.5°C (50% chance):",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 30), fill=(140,175,205))
draw.text((x0+28, cy_l+54), "~500 GtCO₂ from 2020",
          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf", 36), fill=TEAL)
cy_l += cb_h + 26
draw.text((x0, cy_l), "27% reduction by 2030 for 2.0°C pathway",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34), fill=(128,158,194)); cy_l += 48

ry = mit_top + 84
levers = [

    "Electrification of transport",
    "Demand-side efficiency improvements",
    "Protection & restoration of carbon sinks",
    "Scaled climate finance (gap: 3–6× current flows)",
]
for lever in levers:
    draw.ellipse([right_x, ry+16, right_x+14, ry+30], fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((right_x+34, ry), lever,

    "Choices made this decade will determine whether warming can be held to 1.5°C or 2°C.",
    font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 74), x0, cy, CREAM, max_w=TW-30, lh=86)

# Three consequence boxes
PIL_W = (TW - 48) // 3
BOX_H = 280
for j,(color,title,body) in enumerate([
    (DEEP_RED,  "COST",    "Delayed action exponentially\nincreases mitigation costs\nacross all sectors."),
    (VERMILION, "LOCK-IN", "High-carbon infrastructure\nlock-in reduces future\nfeasibility of limiting warming."),
    (AMBER,     "FINANCE", "Climate finance falls 3–6×\nshort of adaptation needs.\nImmediate scaling required."),
]):
    px = x0 + j*(PIL_W+24)
    draw.rectangle([px,cy,px+PIL_W,cy+BOX_H], fill=color+(20,), outline=color+(105,), width=2)
    draw.text((px+24, cy+18), title,
              font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 100), fill=color)
    for k,ln in enumerate(body.split("\n")):

draw.line([(x0,cy),(W-M,cy)], fill=DEEP_RED+(40,), width=1); cy += 34

          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 66), fill=AMBER); cy += 84

    "Emissions reductions across all sectors and scales are essential to secure a liveable and sustainable future for all.",
    font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40), x0, cy, SLATE_LT, max_w=TW-20, lh=56)

print(f"Content ends at y={cy}  ({cy/H*100:.1f}% of canvas)")

# ── Footer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

draw.line([(x0,footer_y),(W-M,footer_y)], fill=(255,255,255,22), width=1)

          font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 28), fill=(108,144,174))

          font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 28), fill=(108,144,174))

# ── Right edge vertical text ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
lf2 = font("BigShoulders-Regular.ttf", 60)
lbl = "SYNTHESIS  REPORT  ·  AR6"
li = Image.new("RGBA",(800,48),(0,0,0,0))
ld = ImageDraw.Draw(li)
ld.text((0,0),lbl,font=lf2,fill=(255,255,255,26))
lr = li.rotate(90,expand=True)
img.paste(lr,(W-lr.width-6,(H-lr.height)//2),lr)

# ── Temperature legend top-right ──────────────────────────────────────────────
lx = W-M-310; ly = int(H*0.008)+10; lh = 380; lw = 32
for yi in range(lh):
    t = yi/lh
    if t<0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t<0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(lx,ly+yi),(lx+lw,ly+yi)],fill=(r,g,b))
draw.rectangle([lx,ly,lx+lw,ly+lh],outline=(255,255,255,38),width=1)
draw.text((lx+lw+10,ly),     "4.4°C",font=font("Jura-Light.ttf",26),fill=(160,15,15))
draw.text((lx+lw+10,ly+lh-22),"1.1°C",font=font("Jura-Light.ttf",26),fill=TEAL)

# ── Decorative arcs bottom-right ─────────────────────────────────────────────
acx,acy = W-M+100, H-M+100
for ar in range(12):
    r_arc = 120+ar*120
    al = max(3,36-ar*3)
    for ang in range(150,276,2):
        a=math.radians(ang)
        ax1=acx+int((r_arc-4)*math.cos(a)); ay1=acy+int((r_arc-4)*math.sin(a))
        ax2=acx+int(r_arc*math.cos(a));     ay2=acy+int(r_arc*math.sin(a))
        draw.line([(ax1,ay1),(ax2,ay2)],fill=(255,255,255,al))

out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out,"PNG",dpi=(DPI,DPI))
print(f"Saved: {out}  ({W}×{H})")

"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Full A0 Canvas
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
Target: fill the full A0 canvas with authoritative, data-forward design
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY       = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER      = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION  = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED   = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL       = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM      = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT   = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(draw, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(draw, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        return y + (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40) + 6
    lines = wrap(draw, text, fnt, max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 10)
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += step
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

STRIP_W = int(W * 0.014)
M = int(W * 0.048)
x0 = STRIP_W + 4 + M
TW = W - M - x0

# ── Background dots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 54):
    for gy in range(0, H, 54):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,13))

# ── Left thermal gradient strip ───────────────────────────────────────────────
for y in range(H):
    t = y / H   # 0=top, 1=bottom
    if t < 0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))
draw.line([(STRIP_W+2,0),(STRIP_W+2,H)], fill=(255,255,255,40), width=2)

def hrule(y, color=WHITE, opacity=28, thick=1, gap=24):
    draw.line([(x0,y),(W-M,y)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thick)
    return y + thick + gap

def sec_header(y, text, color=TEAL, gap_after=56):
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 38), fill=color)
    return y + gap_after

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER  (~14% of canvas)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.009)

draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+182, cy+24),

"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Full A0 Canvas (Final)
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
Target: truly fill all 7021px height with authoritative visual weight
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY      = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER     = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED  = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL      = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE     = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM     = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT  = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(draw_obj, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(draw_obj, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        draw_obj.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        return y + (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40) + 8
    lines = wrap(draw_obj, text, fnt, max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 10)
    for ln in lines:
        draw_obj.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += step
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

STRIP_W = int(W * 0.014)
M = int(W * 0.048)
x0 = STRIP_W + 4 + M
TW = W - M - x0

# ── Background dot grid ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 56):
    for gy in range(0, H, 56):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,12))

# ── Thermal gradient strip (left edge) ────────────────────────────────────────
for y in range(H):
    t = y / H  # 0=top(hottest), 1=bottom(coolest)
    if t < 0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))
draw.line([(STRIP_W+2,0),(STRIP_W+2,H)], fill=(255,255,255,40), width=2)

def hrule(y, color=WHITE, opacity=28, thick=1, before=0, after=30):
    y += before
    draw.line([(x0,y),(W-M,y)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thick)
    return y + thick + after

def sec_lbl(y, text, color=TEAL, after=64):
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 40), fill=color)
    return y + after

# ─── LAYOUT PLAN (target filling all 7021px) ──────────────────────────────────
# Header       ~18%  => ~1264 px
# Observed     ~15%  => ~1053 px
# Projections  ~14%  => ~983 px
# Risks        ~17%  => ~1194 px
# Mitigation   ~20%  => ~1404 px
# Window       ~14%  => ~983 px
# Footer       ~2%   => ~140 px

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER  (target y_end ≈ 1260)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.010)

draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+204, cy+26),
          "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  AR6  ·  2023",
          font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 46), fill=(168,195,220))
cy += 108

# Massive title — fills full width
draw.text((x0, cy), "CLIMATE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 560), fill=WHITE)
cy += 540
draw.text((x0, cy), "CHANGE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 560), fill=WHITE)
cy += 524

draw.text((x0, cy), "2023",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 100), fill=AMBER)
draw.text((x0+282, cy+26),
          "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 56), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 118

cy = hrule(cy, color=WHITE, opacity=42, thick=2, before=18, after=10)
cy = hrule(cy, color=AMBER,  opacity=58, thick=1, before=6, after=44)
print(f"Header end: {cy} ({cy/H*100:.1f}%)")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — OBSERVED CHANGES  (target end ≈ 2313)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_lbl(cy, "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE", after=64)

# Three metric cards
CARD_H = 400
GAP    = 40

IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Full A0 Canvas (Final)
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
Target: truly fill all 7021px height with authoritative visual weight
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150

H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY      = (10,  16,  40)

VERMILION = (220,  68,  35)

TEAL      = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE     = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM     = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT  = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(draw_obj, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(draw_obj, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        draw_obj.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        return y + (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40) + 8
    lines = wrap(draw_obj, text, fnt, max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 10)
    for ln in lines:
        draw_obj.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += step
    return y

import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY      = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER     = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED  = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL      = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE     = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM     = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT  = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(draw_obj, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(draw_obj, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        draw_obj.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        return y + (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40) + 8
    lines = wrap(draw_obj, text, fnt, max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 10)
    for ln in lines:
        draw_obj.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += step
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

STRIP_W = int(W * 0.014)
M = int(W * 0.048)
x0 = STRIP_W + 4 + M
TW = W - M - x0

# ── Background dot grid ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 56):
    for gy in range(0, H, 56):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,12))

# ── Thermal gradient strip (left edge) ────────────────────────────────────────
for y in range(H):
    t = y / H  # 0=top(hottest), 1=bottom(coolest)
    if t < 0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))
draw.line([(STRIP_W+2,0),(STRIP_W+2,H)], fill=(255,255,255,40), width=2)

def hrule(y, color=WHITE, opacity=28, thick=1, before=0, after=30):
    y += before
    draw.line([(x0,y),(W-M,y)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thick)
    return y + thick + after

def sec_lbl(y, text, color=TEAL, after=64):
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 40), fill=color)
    return y + after

# ─── LAYOUT PLAN (target filling all 7021px) ──────────────────────────────────
# Header       ~18%  => ~1264 px
# Observed     ~15%  => ~1053 px

# Three metric cards
CARD_H = 400
GAP    = 40

raw_arguments.content:
"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report Poster — Full A0 Canvas (Final)
Design Philosophy: Thermal Cartography
Target: truly fill all 7021px height with authoritative visual weight
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

DPI = 150
A0_W_IN, A0_H_IN = 33.11, 46.81
W = int(A0_W_IN * DPI)   # 4966
H = int(A0_H_IN * DPI)   # 7021

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

NAVY      = (10,  16,  40)
AMBER     = (255, 175,  35)
VERMILION = (220,  68,  35)
DEEP_RED  = (160,  18,  18)
TEAL      = ( 55, 178, 165)
WHITE     = (255, 255, 255)
CREAM     = (238, 228, 205)
SLATE_LT  = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(draw_obj, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur + " " + w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(draw_obj, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        draw_obj.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        return y + (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40) + 8
    lines = wrap(draw_obj, text, fnt, max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] + 10)
    for ln in lines:
        draw_obj.text((x, y), ln, font=fnt, fill=fill)
        y += step
    return y

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img, "RGBA")

STRIP_W = int(W * 0.014)
M = int(W * 0.048)
x0 = STRIP_W + 4 + M
TW = W - M - x0

# ── Background dot grid ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for gx in range(0, W, 56):
    for gy in range(0, H, 56):
        draw.ellipse([gx-1,gy-1,gx+1,gy+1], fill=(255,255,255,12))

# ── Thermal gradient strip (left edge) ────────────────────────────────────────
for y in range(H):
    t = y / H  # 0=top(hottest), 1=bottom(coolest)
    if t < 0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t < 0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:
        tt=(t-0.66)/0.34
        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(0,y),(STRIP_W,y)], fill=(r,g,b))
draw.line([(STRIP_W+2,0),(STRIP_W+2,H)], fill=(255,255,255,40), width=2)

def hrule(y, color=WHITE, opacity=28, thick=1, before=0, after=30):
    y += before
    draw.line([(x0,y),(W-M,y)], fill=color+(opacity,), width=thick)
    return y + thick + after

def sec_lbl(y, text, color=TEAL, after=64):
    draw.text((x0, y), text, font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 40), fill=color)
    return y + after

# ─── LAYOUT PLAN (target filling all 7021px) ──────────────────────────────────
# Header       ~18%  => ~1264 px
# Observed     ~15%  => ~1053 px
# Projections  ~14%  => ~983 px
# Risks        ~17%  => ~1194 px
# Mitigation   ~20%  => ~1404 px
# Window       ~14%  => ~983 px
# Footer       ~2%   => ~140 px

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER  (target y_end ≈ 1260)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = int(H * 0.010)

draw.text((x0, cy), "IPCC",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90), fill=TEAL)
draw.text((x0+204, cy+26),
          "Sixth Assessment Report  ·  AR6  ·  2023",
          font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf", 46), fill=(168,195,220))
cy += 108

# Massive title — fills full width
draw.text((x0, cy), "CLIMATE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 560), fill=WHITE)
cy += 540
draw.text((x0, cy), "CHANGE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 560), fill=WHITE)
cy += 524

draw.text((x0, cy), "2023",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 100), fill=AMBER)
draw.text((x0+282, cy+26),
          "AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 56), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy += 118

cy = hrule(cy, color=WHITE, opacity=42, thick=2, before=18, after=10)
cy = hrule(cy, color=AMBER,  opacity=58, thick=1, before=6, after=44)
print(f"Header end: {cy} ({cy/H*100:.1f}%)")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — OBSERVED CHANGES  (target end ≈ 2313)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_lbl(cy, "OBSERVED CHANGES  ·  CURRENT STATE", after=64)

# Three metric cards
CARD_H = 400
GAP    = 40
CW     = (TW - 2*GAP) // 3

def card(x, y, cw, ch, val, unit, label, accent):
    draw.rectangle([x,y,x+cw,y+ch], fill=(255,255,255,9), outline=accent+(55,), width=2)
    vf = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 224)
    draw.text((x+30, y+14), val, font=vf, fill=accent)
    uf = font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 48)
    draw.text((x+34+vf.getbbox(val)[2], y+94), unit, font=uf, fill=accent+(180,))
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
    lines = wrap(draw, label, lf, cw-60)
    ly = y + ch - 22 - len(lines)*44
    for ln in lines:
        draw.text((x+30, ly), ln, font=lf, fill=SLATE_LT); ly += 44

card(x0,             cy, CW, CARD_H, "1.1","°C",
     "Global surface temperature rise (2011–2020 vs. pre-industrial 1850–1900)", AMBER)
card(x0+CW+GAP,      cy, CW, CARD_H, "410","ppm",
     "Atmospheric CO₂ in 2019 — highest in at least 2 million years", VERMILION)
card(x0+2*(CW+GAP),  cy, CW, CARD_H, "59","GtCO₂e",
     "Global GHG emissions in 2019", DEEP_RED)
cy += CARD_H + 44

# Secondary strip
draw.text((x0, cy),
    "Sea level rise 1901–2018:  +0.20 m        ·        Arctic sea ice (Sept, 1979–2020):  −40% area loss",
    font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf", 36), fill=(145,175,210))
cy += 72
cy = hrule(cy, after=36)
print(f"Sec1 end:   {cy} ({cy/H*100:.1f}%)")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2 — FUTURE PROJECTIONS  (target end ≈ 3296)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_lbl(cy, "FUTURE PROJECTIONS  ·  SSP SCENARIOS", after=58)

BLW = int(TW * 0.14); BGW = int(TW * 0.52)
BVLW = 176; BDEW = TW - BLW - BGW - BVLW
BAR_H = 94; BAR_GAP = 28; MAX_T = 4.4

draw.text((x0+BLW+4, cy-8),
    "PROJECTED WARMING BY 2100  (°C above pre-industrial baseline)",
    font=font("Jura-Light.ttf", 34), fill=(135,168,205))
cy += 52

scenarios = [
    ("SSP1-1.9", 1.4, TEAL,          "Very low emissions · Sustainability focus"),
    ("SSP1-2.6", 1.8, (78,205,185),  "Low emissions"),
    ("SSP2-4.5", 2.7, AMBER,          "Intermediate emissions"),
    ("SSP3-7.0", 3.6, VERMILION,      "High emissions"),
    ("SSP5-8.5", 4.4, DEEP_RED,       "Very high emissions · Fossil-fuel intensive"),
]
bar_top = cy
b11_x = x0+BLW+int(1.1/MAX_T*BGW)
t15_x  = x0+BLW+int(1.5/MAX_T*BGW)
t20_x  = x0+BLW+int(2.0/MAX_T*BGW)

for i,(name,val,color,desc) in enumerate(scenarios):
    by = cy+i*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)
    draw.rectangle([x0+BLW,by+BAR_H//2-2,x0+BLW+BGW,by+BAR_H//2+2],fill=(255,255,255,16))
    draw.rectangle([b11_x,by+18,x0+BLW+int(val/MAX_T*BGW),by+BAR_H-18],fill=color+(205,))
    draw.text((x0+4,by+BAR_H//2-22),name,font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",42),fill=color)
    draw.text((x0+BLW+BGW+14,by+BAR_H//2-28),f"{val}°C",
              font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",52),fill=color)
    draw.text((x0+BLW+BGW+BVLW,by+BAR_H//2-18),desc,
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",30),fill=(132,163,198))

bar_bot = cy+len(scenarios)*(BAR_H+BAR_GAP)
draw.line([(t15_x,bar_top-12),(t15_x,bar_bot)],fill=TEAL+(165,),width=3)
draw.text((t15_x+7,bar_top-46),"1.5°C",font=font("Jura-Medium.ttf",34),fill=TEAL)
draw.line([(t20_x,bar_top-12),(t20_x,bar_bot)],fill=AMBER+(105,),width=2)
draw.text((t20_x+7,bar_top-46),"2.0°C",font=font("Jura-Light.ttf",32),fill=AMBER+(155,))

cy = bar_bot + 34
draw.text((x0,cy),
    "Sea level rise by 2100:  SSP1-1.9 → 0.28–0.55 m     ·     SSP5-8.5 → 0.63–1.01 m  (continued rise for centuries to millennia)",
    font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",32),fill=(132,163,198))
cy += 70
cy = hrule(cy, after=36)
print(f"Sec2 end:   {cy} ({cy/H*100:.1f}%)")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3 — RISKS & IMPACTS  (target end ≈ 4490)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_lbl(cy, "RISKS  ·  VULNERABILITIES  ·  CASCADING IMPACTS", after=60)

COL_SPLIT = int(TW * 0.50)
bullet_x  = x0 + COL_SPLIT + 90

hero_start = cy
draw.text((x0,cy), "3.3–3.6",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 430), fill=DEEP_RED)
cy_l = cy+416
draw.text((x0,cy_l), "BILLION PEOPLE",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 170), fill=VERMILION)
cy_l += 164
draw.text((x0,cy_l), "exposed to severe climate hazards",
          font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",54), fill=SLATE_LT)
cy_l += 76

ry = hero_start + 12
impacts = [
    ("FOOD",    "Crop yield growth slowing in many regions;\nfisheries productivity declining in tropical zones"),
    ("WATER",   ">50% of global population faces severe\nwater scarcity for at least 1 month per year"),
    ("HEALTH",  "Heat-related mortality rising; vector-borne\ndisease ranges expanding globally"),
    ("BIODIV.", "Up to 14% of terrestrial species face very\nhigh extinction risk at 1.5°C of warming"),
]
for label,body in impacts:
    draw.text((bullet_x,ry),label,font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",44),fill=AMBER)
    ry+=54
    for ln in body.split("\n"):
        draw.text((bullet_x,ry),ln,font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",34),fill=SLATE_LT)
        ry+=46
    ry+=38

cy = max(cy_l, ry)+24
cy = hrule(cy, after=36)
print(f"Sec3 end:   {cy} ({cy/H*100:.1f}%)")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4 — MITIGATION  (target end ≈ 5894)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_lbl(cy, "MITIGATION PATHWAYS  ·  ADAPTATION", after=60)

left_w = int(TW*0.46); right_x = x0+left_w+100; right_w = TW-left_w-100
mit_top = cy

# 43% hero — largest possible
draw.text((x0,cy), "43%",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 470), fill=AMBER)
cy_l = cy+454
draw.text((x0,cy_l), "REQUIRED REDUCTION",
          font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 130), fill=AMBER)
cy_l += 126
cy_l = put(draw,
    "in global GHG emissions by 2030 below 2019 levels — the 1.5°C pathway",
    font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",44), x0, cy_l, SLATE_LT, max_w=left_w, lh=60)
cy_l += 42
draw.text((x0,cy_l),"Net zero CO₂  →  ~2050  for 1.5°C pathway",
    font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",38),fill=TEAL); cy_l+=56
draw.text((x0,cy_l),"Net zero CO₂  →  ~2070  for 2.0°C pathway",
    font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",38),fill=(88,152,146)); cy_l+=70

cb_h = 110
draw.rectangle([x0,cy_l,x0+left_w,cy_l+cb_h],fill=(255,255,255,8),outline=TEAL+(70,),width=2)
draw.text((x0+30,cy_l+16),"Remaining carbon budget for 1.5°C (50% chance):",
    font=font("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",32),fill=(140,175,205))
draw.text((x0+30,cy_l+60),"~500 GtCO₂ from 2020",
    font=font("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",40),fill=TEAL)
cy_l += cb_h+30
draw.text((x0,cy_l),"27% reduction by 2030 for 2.0°C pathway",
    font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",36),fill=(128,158,194)); cy_l+=50

# Right: Key levers
draw.text((right_x,mit_top),"KEY LEVERS",
          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",68),fill=SLATE_LT)
ry = mit_top+90
levers = [
    "Rapid decarbonization of energy systems",
    "Electrification of transport",
    "Demand-side efficiency improvements",
    "Protection & restoration of carbon sinks",
    "Scaled climate finance (gap: 3–6× current flows)",
]
for lever in levers:
    draw.ellipse([right_x,ry+18,right_x+16,ry+34],fill=TEAL)
    draw.text((right_x+38,ry),lever,
              font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",42),fill=SLATE_LT)
    ry+=74

cy = max(cy_l, ry)+28
cy = hrule(cy, after=36)
print(f"Sec4 end:   {cy} ({cy/H*100:.1f}%)")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5 — NARROWING WINDOW  (target end ≈ 6881)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cy = sec_lbl(cy, "THE NARROWING WINDOW FOR ACTION", color=VERMILION, after=56)

cy = put(draw,
    "Choices made this decade will determine whether warming can be held to 1.5°C or 2°C.",
    font("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf",84), x0, cy, CREAM, max_w=TW-30, lh=100)
cy += 50

PIL_W = (TW-56)//3; BOX_H = 320
for j,(color,title,body) in enumerate([
    (DEEP_RED,  "COST",    "Delayed action exponentially\nincreases mitigation costs\nacross all sectors."),
    (VERMILION, "LOCK-IN", "High-carbon infrastructure\nlock-in reduces future\nfeasibility of limiting warming."),
    (AMBER,     "FINANCE", "Climate finance falls 3–6×\nshort of adaptation needs.\nImmediate scaling required."),
]):
    px = x0+j*(PIL_W+28)
    draw.rectangle([px,cy,px+PIL_W,cy+BOX_H],fill=color+(20,),outline=color+(105,),width=2)
    draw.text((px+26,cy+20),title,font=font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",120),fill=color)
    for k,ln in enumerate(body.split("\n")):
        draw.text((px+26,cy+148+k*52),ln,
                  font=font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",34),fill=SLATE_LT)

cy += BOX_H+48
draw.line([(x0,cy),(W-M,cy)],fill=DEEP_RED+(95,),width=5); cy+=10
draw.line([(x0,cy),(W-M,cy)],fill=DEEP_RED+(40,),width=1); cy+=38

draw.text((x0,cy),"IMMEDIATE  ·  DEEP  ·  SUSTAINED",
          font=font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",76),fill=AMBER); cy+=94

    "Emissions reductions across all sectors and scales are essential to secure a liveable and sustainable future for all.",
    font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",44), x0, cy, SLATE_LT, max_w=TW-20, lh=62)

# ── Concentric arcs bottom-right ─────────────────────────────────────────────

for ar in range(14):
    r_arc=120+ar*130; al=max(3,34-ar*2)
    for ang in range(148,278,2):
        a=math.radians(ang)
        ax1=acx+int((r_arc-4)*math.cos(a)); ay1=acy+int((r_arc-4)*math.sin(a))
        ax2=acx+int(r_arc*math.cos(a));     ay2=acy+int(r_arc*math.sin(a))
        draw.line([(ax1,ay1),(ax2,ay2)],fill=(255,255,255,al))

# ── Temperature legend top-right ─────────────────────────────────────────────
lx=W-M-330; ly=int(H*0.008)+10; lh=440; lw=36
for yi in range(lh):
    t=yi/lh
    if t<0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))

    elif t<0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))

        r=int(AMBER[0]+tt*(TEAL[0]-AMBER[0]))
        g=int(AMBER[1]+tt*(TEAL[1]-AMBER[1]))
        b=int(AMBER[2]+tt*(TEAL[2]-AMBER[2]))
    draw.line([(lx,ly+yi),(lx+lw,ly+yi)],fill=(r,g,b))

SLATE_LT  = (160, 190, 220)

def font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def wrap(d, text, fnt, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = (cur+" "+w).strip()
        if fnt.getbbox(test)[2] > max_w and cur:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = test
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

def put(d, text, fnt, x, y, fill, max_w=None, lh=None):
    if max_w is None:
        d.text((x,y),text,font=fnt,fill=fill)
        return y+(fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3] or 40)+8
    lines = wrap(d,text,fnt,max_w)
    step = lh or (fnt.getbbox("Ag")[3]+10)
    for ln in lines:
        d.text((x,y),ln,font=fnt,fill=fill); y+=step
    return y

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img,"RGBA")

for gx in range(0,W,56):

# ── Horizontal warm bands (subtle, full width) ────────────────────────────────
# Very subtle banding to suggest latitude/temperature zones
for band_i in range(6):
    band_y = int(H * (0.2 + band_i*0.13))
    for dy in range(-2, 3):
        draw.line([(0,band_y+dy),(W,band_y+dy)],fill=(255,200,100, 5))

# ── Left thermal strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for y in range(H):
    t = y/H
    if t<0.33:
        r=int(DEEP_RED[0]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[0]-DEEP_RED[0]))
        g=int(DEEP_RED[1]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[1]-DEEP_RED[1]))
        b=int(DEEP_RED[2]+t/0.33*(VERMILION[2]-DEEP_RED[2]))
    elif t<0.66:
        tt=(t-0.33)/0.33
        r=int(VERMILION[0]+tt*(AMBER[0]-VERMILION[0]))
        g=int(VERMILION[1]+tt*(AMBER[1]-VERMILION[1]))
        b=int(VERMILION[2]+tt*(AMBER[2]-VERMILION[2]))
    else:

draw.line([(STRIP_W+2,0),(STRIP_W+2,H)],fill=(255,255,255,42),width=2)

def hrule(y,color=WHITE,opacity=28,thick=1,before=0,after=32):
    y+=before
    draw.line([(x0,y),(W-M,y)],fill=color+(opacity,),width=thick)

    draw.text((x0,y),text,font=font("Jura-Light.ttf",42),fill=color)
